showsLine: Every film and live-action series — the Avengers, the Defenders, Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. and the Disney+ originals — plus Special Presentations, One-Shots and web shorts

episodes.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
episodes.description: During World War II, Steve Rogers is a sickly man from Brooklyn who's transformed into super-soldier Captain America to aid in the war effort. Rogers must stop the Red Skull – Adolf Hitler's ruthless head of weaponry, and the leader of an organization that intends to use a mysterious device of untold powers for world domination.

episodes.title: Agent Carter
episodes.description: Agent Peggy Carter is relegated to a desk job and frustrated at her male boss and comrades' sexist dismissal of her place in the SSR. Ordered to work late one night, Carter gets an alert that the villain Zodiac has been spotted and decides to take care of it herself.

episodes.title: Now Is Not the End
episodes.description: In the premiere episode, "Pilot," when old acquaintance Howard Stark finds himself being framed for unleashing his deadliest weapons to anyone willing to pony up the cash, he contacts Peggy -- the only person he can trust -- to track down those responsible, dispose of the weapons and clear his name. He empowers his butler, Edwin Jarvis, to be at her beck and call when needed to help assist her as she investigates and tracks down those responsible for selling these weapons of mass destruction. If caught going on these secret missions for Stark, Peggy could be targeted as a traitor and spend the rest of her days in prison - or worse.

episodes.title: Bridge and Tunnel
episodes.description: In the episode, "Bridge and Tunnel," Howard Stark's deadliest weapon has fallen into enemy hands, and only Agent Carter can recover it. But can she do so before her undercover mission is discovered by SSR Chief Dooley and Agent Thompson?

episodes.title: Time and Tide
episodes.description: As Agent Carter closes in on Howard Stark's stolen technology, Peggy's secret mission could unravel when the SSR arrests Jarvis and a secret is revealed.

episodes.title: The Blitzkrieg Button
episodes.description: Peggy may be in more trouble than usual when fugitive Howard Stark suddenly returns for mysterious reasons. And Chief Dooley chases a new clue all the way to Europe that threatens to destroy Peggy's future at the SSR.

episodes.title: The Iron Ceiling
episodes.description: Peggy is finally trusted with a mission and calls upon her trusted Howling Commandos squad for backup. But her cover could be at risk when SSR Chief Dooley also sends Agent Thompson with her.

episodes.title: A Sin to Err
episodes.description: Peggy discovers the shocking truth about Leviathan but doesn't realize that her true enemies are even closer than she imagined. Meanwhile, Souza is close to confirming the truth about Peggy and may just put her in the crosshairs of the SSR.

episodes.title: Snafu
episodes.description: Peggy is cornered and more vulnerable than ever as Leviathan makes their move against her. As the SSR zeroes in on Howard Stark, they may pay the ultimate price as they find their true enemy is closer than they realized.

episodes.title: Valediction
episodes.description: Peggy faces the full fury of Leviathan, as Howard Stark makes his return in the explosive season finale.

episodes.title: The Lady in the Lake
episodes.description: After the SSR captures Dottie, Jack sends Peggy to LA to help Daniel... and get Peggy out of his hair. However, she's soon swept up in a new investigation when a woman is found in a block of ice next to a frozen lake.

episodes.title: A View in the Dark
episodes.description: Peggy continues her investigation of Isodyne, and Jason offers to betray his employers to help her. Meanwhile, the Council shuts down Calvin's zero matter project, and Whitney has an unfortunate accident.

episodes.title: Better Angels
episodes.description: Peggy continues her investigation into Isodyne, and the trail leads her to the Atlas Club. However, Jack refuses to believe her testimony and continues meeting with Vernon. Meanwhile, Calvin sends his assassin to dispose of Peggy, and Howard meets with a scientific genius.

episodes.title: Smoke & Mirrors
episodes.description: Peggy captures Calvin's hired killer Rufus and interrogates him. However, before she can act on the information Rufus gives her, Vernon steps in and stops the SSR investigations. In the past, the events that led Peggy and Whitney to their current lives are revealed.

episodes.title: The Atomic Job
episodes.description: When Peggy learns that Whitney and Calvin plan to steal atomic bombs from Roxxon to recreate the zero matter experiment, she organizes a team to stop the couple and get the bombs first.

episodes.title: Life of the Party
episodes.description: Due to her injury, Peggy has no choice but to turn to an unexpected ally to get a sample of the zero matter from Whitney. Meanwhile, Whitney takes control of the Council, and Jarvis attends a party.

episodes.title: Monsters
episodes.description: Peggy and Jarvis go to rescue Dottie from Whitney, unaware that it's a trap... but not for them. Meanwhile, Vernon warns Daniel that he can cooperate with his superiors... or else.

episodes.title: The Edge of Mystery
episodes.description: Peggy offers Whitney the uranium rods in return for Jason, only to discover that there's a traitor in their midst. Meanwhile, Jarvis asks Rose to look after Ana, and Daniel is forced to choose between Peggy and the mission success.

episodes.title: A Little Song and Dance
episodes.description: Jack betrays Daniel and Samberly to Vernon and his conspirators... or does he? Meanwhile, Peggy is forced into an uneasy alliance to rescue Jason, only to discover that her ally isn't necessarily on her side.

episodes.title: Hollywood Ending
episodes.description: Howard, Jason, and Samberly race against the clock to find a way to reopen the rift and send the Zero Matter back to where it came... and receive help from an unexpected ally in their quest.

episodes.title: Captain Marvel
episodes.description: The story follows Carol Danvers as she becomes one of the universe’s most powerful heroes when Earth is caught in the middle of a galactic war between two alien races. Set in the 1990s, Captain Marvel is an all-new adventure from a previously unseen period in the history of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

episodes.title: Iron Man
episodes.description: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

episodes.title: Stark Expo Videos
episodes.description: Promotional web campaign for the Stark Expo 2010: an in-universe website with videos, including a welcome message from Tony Stark and a nostalgic promotion for the 1974 Expo.

episodes.title: Iron Man 2
episodes.description: With the world now aware of his dual life as the armored superhero Iron Man, billionaire inventor Tony Stark faces pressure from the government, the press and the public to share his technology with the military. Unwilling to let go of his invention, Stark, with Pepper Potts and James 'Rhodey' Rhodes at his side, must forge new alliances – and confront powerful enemies.

episodes.title: The Incredible Hulk
episodes.description: Scientist Bruce Banner scours the planet for an antidote to the unbridled force of rage within him: the Hulk. But when the military masterminds who dream of exploiting his powers force him back to civilization, he finds himself coming face to face with a new, deadly foe.

episodes.key: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer|1|1
episodes.show: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer
episodes.title: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer
episodes.description: Agent Coulson stops at a convenience store and deals with a coincidental robbery during his visit.

episodes.title: Thor
episodes.description: Against his father Odin's will, The Mighty Thor - a powerful but arrogant warrior god - recklessly reignites an ancient war. Thor is cast down to Earth and forced to live among humans as punishment. Once here, Thor learns what it takes to be a true hero when the most dangerous villain of his world sends the darkest forces of Asgard to invade Earth.

episodes.title: The Consultant
episodes.description: Agent Coulson informs Agent Sitwell that the World Security Council wishes Emil Blonsky to be released from prison to join the Avengers Initiative. As Nick Fury doesn't want to release Blonsky, the two agents decide to send a patsy to sabotage the meeting...

episodes.title: The Avengers
episodes.description: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D., finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. Spanning the globe, a daring recruitment effort begins!

episodes.title: Item 47
episodes.description: Benny and Claire, a down-on-their-luck couple, find a discarded Chitauri weapon referred to as 'Item 47'.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: Joss Whedon, the creative genius behind the feature film "Marvel's The Avengers," one of the highest grossing films of all time, and of the iconic television series "Buffy The Vampire Slayer," has co-created "Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.," a dynamic, action-packed one-hour drama that brings back Agent Phil Coulson to lead a team of highly skilled agents to investigate extra-normal and super human people and events worldwide.

Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. agents travel to Peru to investigate an object of unknown origin, codenamed 0-8-4. But when he runs into Comandante Camilla Reyes, more than just sparks fly at 30,000 feet.

episodes.title: The Asset
episodes.description: When the brilliant scientist Dr. Franklin Hall is kidnapped, Agent Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. agents must race against the clock to locate him. Skye is their only way in -- pushing the team to their limits when the entire plan turns upside-down.

episodes.title: Eye Spy
episodes.description: Agent Coulson and the S.H.I.E.L.D. team try to track down a mysterious woman who has single-handedly committed numerous high-stakes heists. But when the woman's identity is revealed, a troubling secret stands to ruin Coulson.

episodes.title: Girl in the Flower Dress
episodes.description: An elusive girl in a flower dress may hold the key to the mystery that brings Coulson and team to Asia to rescue a young man with an unusual and dangerous power. Meanwhile, Skye has a secret that jeopardizes her relationship with the team right when they need her most.

episodes.title: FZZT
episodes.description: When floating bodies turn up, Coulson and the Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D must hunt down an elusive killer. No one is safe -- not even the team.

episodes.title: The Hub
episodes.description: Dangerous secrets are being kept from Coulson's team and he works the system to save Ward and Fitz when they are sent on a Level 8 classified mission that may end in tragedy.

episodes.title: Thor: The Dark World
episodes.description: Thor fights to restore order across the cosmos… but an ancient race led by the vengeful Malekith returns to plunge the universe back into darkness. Faced with an enemy that even Odin and Asgard cannot withstand, Thor must embark on his most perilous and personal journey yet, one that will reunite him with Jane Foster and force him to sacrifice everything to save us all.

episodes.title: The Well
episodes.description: In the aftermath of the events chronicled in the feature film THOR: THE DARK WORLD, Coulson and The Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. pick up the pieces -- one of which threatens to destroy a member of the team.

episodes.title: Repairs
episodes.description: Coulson and his team are haunted by a mysterious force that threatens to destroy them all, and only a secret from May's past can save them.

episodes.title: The Bridge
episodes.description: In a shocking cliffhanger episode, Coulson takes the war back to Centipede, and this time he brings in Mike Peterson for some super-soldier support. As they get closer to the truth, startling secrets are revealed and an unexpected twist threatens the team.

episodes.title: Iron Man 3
episodes.description: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.

episodes.title: All Hail the King
episodes.description: A documentary filmmaker interviews the now-famous Trevor Slattery from behind bars.

episodes.title: The Magical Place
episodes.description: Coulson uncovers vital information about the mystery of his death, but, with Centipede out for blood, this knowledge may come at the cost of one of the team.

episodes.title: Seeds
episodes.description: Coulson and May uncover startling information about Skye's past, while the team is swept into a storm at S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy.

episodes.title: T.R.A.C.K.S.
episodes.description: Hot on the trail of the Clairvoyant, Coulson and his team board a mystery train that seems to be headed for certain death.

episodes.title: T.A.H.I.T.I.
episodes.description: Coulson goes on the attack to save Skye - enlisting the aid of Ward's former S.O. John Garrett -- and uncovers shocking truths about his own life and S.H.I.E.L.D..

episodes.title: Yes Men
episodes.description: When Coulson and his team are attacked by Lorelei - a deadly seductress who escaped from Asgard - Thor's Lady Sif, her longtime nemesis, steps in to try to save them.

episodes.title: End of the Beginning
episodes.description: Agents Garrett and Triplett are back to help Coulson's team track down S.H.I.E.L.D.'S nefarious enemy - the Clairvoyant. But will Deathlok destroy them all to protect his master's identity?

episodes.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
episodes.description: After the cataclysmic events in New York with The Avengers, Steve Rogers, aka Captain America is living quietly in Washington, D.C. and trying to adjust to the modern world. But when a S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague comes under attack, Steve becomes embroiled in a web of intrigue that threatens to put the world at risk. Joining forces with the Black Widow, Captain America struggles to expose the ever-widening conspiracy while fighting off professional assassins sent to silence him at every turn. When the full scope of the villainous plot is revealed, Captain America and the Black Widow enlist the help of a new ally, the Falcon. However, they soon find themselves up against an unexpected and formidable enemy—the Winter Soldier.

episodes.title: Turn, Turn, Turn
episodes.description: Coulson and his team find themselves without anyone they can trust, only to discover that they are trapped with a traitor in their midst.

episodes.title: Providence
episodes.description: With Colonel Glenn Talbot now on their trail, Coulson and his team seek refuge in the last place anyone would look, where they begin to uncover S.H.I.E.L.D.'s most dangerous secrets -- secrets that could destroy them all.

episodes.title: The Only Light in the Darkness
episodes.description: With their world turned upside down, Coulson races to save the life of his one true love as the mystery of "The Cellist," which began in Marvel's The Avengers.

episodes.title: Nothing Personal
episodes.description: Just when there's no one left to trust, Agent Maria Hill -- from "Marvel's The Avengers" and "Marvel's Captain America: The Winter Solider" -- returns to team up with Coulson as S.H.I.E.L.D. is being destroyed around them.

episodes.title: Ragtag
episodes.description: In the last episode before the epic season finale, Ward's betrayal and HYDRA's shocking secrets are revealed as Coulson's team goes undercover on a mission that leaves no one unscathed.

episodes.title: Beginning of the End
episodes.description: Dark secrets are revealed as Coulson and his team put everything on the line to stop Garrett and the forces of HYDRA.

episodes.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
episodes.description: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.

episodes.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
episodes.description: The Guardians must fight to keep their newfound family together as they unravel the mysteries of Peter Quill's true parentage.

episodes.title: Into the Ring
episodes.description: Matt Murdock, a Marvel Comics hero who's a lawyer by day but fights the bad guys at night to avenge the murder of his father, a boxer. But what sets Matt apart from most superheroes isn't his back story it's his handicap. Matt is blind, the result of a childhood accident that may have removed his ability to see but gifted him with heightened senses of touch, taste, hearing and smell.

episodes.title: Cut Man
episodes.description: As Claire nurses Matt back to health, she discovers that her patient is much more than an ordinary man. Meanwhile, Matt recalls the events that led to him becoming Daredevil.

episodes.title: Rabbit in a Snowstorm
episodes.description: Murdock and Foggy take on a mysterious wealthy client, but Murdock is convinced that there's more to the case than just the facts.

episodes.title: In the Blood
episodes.description: Daredevil goes after the Russians who have abducted Claire. Meanwhile, Wilson goes on a dinner date with Vanessa.

episodes.title: World on Fire
episodes.description: Fisk moves forward with plans that threaten to rip Hell's Kitchen apart. Murdock and Foggy take on a case helping tenants victimized by a slumlord.

episodes.title: Condemned
episodes.description: Daredevil finds himself trapped in the fallout of Fisk's plan to take control of Hell's Kitchen. Ben Urich digs closer to the truth.

episodes.title: Stick
episodes.description: An important figure from Murdock's past reemerges seeking his help to battle a new enemy threatening Hell's Kitchen.

episodes.title: Shadows in the Glass
episodes.description: While Murdock, Foggy and Karen's mission becomes clearer, Fisk's world spins further out of control in his battle for Hell's Kitchen.

episodes.title: Speak of the Devil
episodes.description: When Fisk gains the upper hand, the goal to destroy him becomes even more difficult, while Daredevil faces his own demons.

episodes.title: Nelson v. Murdock
episodes.description: Murdock and Foggy's relationship is put to the ultimate test while a new enemy against Fisk emerges.

episodes.title: The Path of the Righteous
episodes.description: Fisk and Murdock wrestle with the consequences of their chosen paths, while Ben and Karen get closer to Fisk's true past.

episodes.title: The Ones We Leave Behind
episodes.description: Fisk seeks revenge while Karen is haunted by recent events. Daredevil makes a startling discovery about Fisk's financing.

episodes.title: Daredevil
episodes.description: In the season finale, a boxed-in Fisk and a desperate Murdock, Foggy and Karen are forced to play their end games.

episodes.title: Shadows
episodes.description: Coulson and his team are now wanted fugitives with limited resources -- but that's not stopping them from keeping the world safe from powerful and unseen threats everywhere. However, with new members they hardly know, will S.H.I.E.L.D. ever be trusted again?

episodes.title: Heavy Is the Head
episodes.description: Hunted and running out of solutions, Coulson puts his team right in the line of fire in the hopes of saving them all. But with General Talbot, Hydra and Creel all on the attack, can they possibly survive? Meanwhile, a mysterious Doctor harbors some dangerous secrets that could destroy one of our core team members.

episodes.title: Making Friends and Influencing People
episodes.description: Coulson and his team race against Hydra to get to Donnie Gill -- a dangerous gifted with the ability to freeze objects -- while Simmons is caught in the crossfire.

episodes.title: Face My Enemy
episodes.description: While on a mission to learn more about the secrets of the mysterious writing, Coulson finds himself attacked by the only person he can trust: Agent Melinda May. Meanwhile, the rest of the team is trapped in an explosive situation, and it's up to Fitz to save them -- but is he up to it?

episodes.title: A Hen in the Wolf House
episodes.description: Coulson's team is up against the beautiful and deadly Bobbi Morse -- Security Chief for Hydra. Meanwhile, Skye's father forces Raina to reunite him with his daughter at any cost.

episodes.title: A Fractured House
episodes.description: The world turns against S.H.I.E.L.D. when Hydra impersonates them to attack The United Nations, and an unexpected enemy leads the charge to bring about their downfall.

episodes.title: The Writing on the Wall
episodes.description: The team discovers murder victims with the alien glyphs on them that Coulson's been etching. All of Coulson's secrets and lies come to a head.

episodes.title: AKA Ladies Night
episodes.description: A couple from Omaha ask hard-drinking PI Jessica Jones to find their missing daughter. However, Jessica soon discovers that the man responsible tormented her years ago... and is back for more.

episodes.title: AKA Crush Syndrome
episodes.description: Jessica tracks down Kilgrave to provide Jeri with enough evidence to convince her that a mind-controller exists so that the lawyer will represent Hope. Meanwhile, Jessica and Luke draw closer after a barfight after they both realize the other is more than they seem.

episodes.title: AKA It's Called Whiskey
episodes.description: While Jessica tries to get the anesthesia she needs to negate Kilgrave's mind control powers, Trish interviews Hope on her radio show and makes herself Kilgrave's next target.

episodes.title: AKA 99 Friends
episodes.description: A woman, Audrey Freeman, hires Jessica to get photos of her cheating husband. Jessica suspects that it's another of Kilgrave's traps and follows Audrey to confirm that she's legit. Meanwhile, Trish's radio show brings in a number of Kilgrave's victims, and Jessica finds a clue to Kilgrave's spy.

episodes.title: AKA The Sandwich Saved Me
episodes.description: While Jessica, Trish, and Will try to get close enough to Kilgrave to drug him, Jessica remembers her burgeoning career as a superhero and how she fell under Kilgrave's control.

episodes.title: AKA You're a Winner!
episodes.description: Luke hires Jessica to track down a teenager whose sister holds evidence showing who killed Luke's wife Reva. Meanwhile, Kilgrave decides to buy a house without using his powers on the owner, while Jessica finds out who hired Sissy to beat Hope.

episodes.title: AKA Top Shelf Perverts
episodes.description: After Kilgrave strikes at someone close to Jessica, she vows to get herself imprisoned in the hopes that they can capture Kilgrave. However, Kilgrave has other plans. Meanwhile, Will ignores Trish's orders and hunts down Kilgrave on his own.

episodes.title: AKA WWJD?
episodes.description: Jessica has no choice but to meet Kilgrave on his own turf... her childhood home. Meanwhile, Will tries to murder Kilgrave and lies to Trish about what he's planning.

episodes.title: AKA Sin Bin
episodes.description: Jessica tries to force Kilgrave to reveal his powers on video so she can get Hope free. Meanwhile, Wendy increases her demands in the divorce settlement, and Jeri begins considering alternatives.

episodes.title: AKA 1,000 Cuts
episodes.description: While Albert struggles to make a vaccine to counter his son's mind control power, Jessica makes a deal with Kilgrave to free Hope. Meanwhile, Wendy takes out her frustrations on Jeri, and Robyn discovers what happened to her brother.

episodes.title: AKA I've Got the Blues
episodes.description: Jessica tries to track down Kilgrave by finding Albert's corpse at the city morgues. Meanwhile, Will asks Trish for a second chance but he has an ulterior motive. In the past, the Walkers take Jessica in and the girl soon discovers what Dorothy is really like.

episodes.title: AKA Take a Bloody Number
episodes.description: Dorothy tries to buy her way back into Trish's life with information about the people backing Kozlov. Meanwhile, Jessica and Luke try to track down Kilgrave and grow closer.

episodes.title: AKA Smile
episodes.description: Jessica and Trish prepare for the final showdown against Kilgrave, but things don't go as planned. Meanwhile, nurse Claire Temple helps Luke when the doctors are unable to treat him due to his impenetrable skin.

episodes.title: The Things We Bury
episodes.description: Coulson and team find themselves in an epic face-off against Hydra to uncover an ancient secret, while Ward kidnaps his brother, Senator Christian Ward, for a violent trip down memory lane.

episodes.title: ...Ye Who Enter Here
episodes.description: Discovers the ancient city before Hydra, but uncovering the secrets may require one of Coulson's team to make the ultimate sacrifice. Meanwhile, May and Skye race to get to Raina before Whitehall takes her.

episodes.title: What They Become
episodes.description: Coulson and Whitehall's forces meet in an explosive confrontation that dramatically alters everyone's fates. Meanwhile, Skye discovers shocking secrets about her past, on the Winter finale.

episodes.title: Aftershocks
episodes.description: In the midseason premiere, "Aftershocks," Coulson's team must deal with the consequences of their war with Hydra as shocking revelations threaten to tear them apart, and Hydra makes a dangerous move that may involve a traitor in S.H.I.E.L.D.'s midst.

episodes.title: Who You Really Are
episodes.description: Coulson and team come to the aid of a confused Lady Sif, who has lost her memory after fighting with a mysterious warrior, whose true mission will send shockwaves through S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, Bobbi and Mac continue to hide their true mission from everyone close to them.

episodes.title: One of Us
episodes.description: Cal seeks revenge on Coulson by assembling a team of Super Villains to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, May calls on renowned Dr. Andrew Garner, her charismatic ex-husband, with a crisis that threatens to tear the team apart.

episodes.title: Love in the Time of HYDRA
episodes.description: Coulson and his team are still reeling from a shocking revelation that leaves the team fractured as they must decide what to do with one of their own. Meanwhile, Bobbi and Mack reveal their true allegiance to Hunter, while elsewhere, Ward and Agent 33 embark on a personal mission.

episodes.title: One Door Closes
episodes.description: War comes to Coulson's doorstep in a way he never anticipated as shocking revelations are brought to light, and Skye struggles to control her new abilities but will soon make a decision that irrevocably changes her life.

episodes.title: Afterlife
episodes.description: As Robert Gonzales makes his move, Coulson must do whatever it takes to protect the future of S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, Skye's journey to control her powers takes a surprising turn when she meets the enigmatic Inhuman named Lincoln.

episodes.title: Melinda
episodes.description: The story of Melinda May's transformation into "The Cavalry" is revealed as she finds herself at a crossroads in the war between Coulson and Gonzales. As Skye learns more about her true heritage from Lincoln, the truth about the Inhumans will send her in a new direction.

episodes.title: The Frenemy of My Enemy
episodes.description: Dangerous new alliance is formed as Coulson and Hunter turn to the last person anyone would expect - Grant Ward! As the war between S.H.I.E.L.D. factions continues, Skye and Lincoln will find themselves drawn into this conflict.

episodes.title: The Dirty Half Dozen
episodes.description: Gonzales and Coulson must find a way to put their differences aside and work together against Hydra, even if it means teaming up with someone they don't trust.

episodes.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
episodes.description: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. As the villainous Ultron emerges, it is up to The Avengers to stop him from enacting his terrible plans, and soon uneasy alliances and unexpected action pave the way for an epic and unique global adventure.

episodes.title: Scars
episodes.description: Skye is torn between her loyalty to S.H.I.E.L.D. and her connection to the Inhumans as tensions rise between the groups -- and Coulson reveals a secret he's been hiding from even those closest to him.

episodes.title: WHIH Newsfront Promo
episodes.description: Christine Everhart shares what's coming up on the next episode of NEWSFRONT.

episodes.title: WHIH Newsfront Top Stories
episodes.description: Christine Everhart reports on the latest news of the day.

episodes.title: WHIH EXCLUSIVE: 2012 VistaCorp break-in security footage involving cyber-criminal Scott Lang
episodes.description: WHIH just obtained the security footage that implicated Scott Lang in the crime against VistaCorp.

episodes.title: S.O.S.: Part 1
episodes.description: In Part 1 of the two-part second-season finale, sacrifices are made by Agent Coulson and his team in order to get through a war, and relationships are permanently altered as a result.

episodes.title: S.O.S.: Part 2
episodes.description: Coulson and his team launch a last-ditch attack on the helicarrier to stop Jiaying from unleashing the Terrigen crystals and wiping out S.H.I.E.L.D.

episodes.title: WIRED Insider Interviews Darren Cross, CEO of Pym Technologies
episodes.description: Darren Cross speaks with WIRED Insider about the future of Pym Technologies.

episodes.title: WHIH EXCLUSIVE: Scott Lang Interview
episodes.description: Christine Everhart talks one-on-one with cyber-criminal Scott Lang via video interview from San Quentin.

episodes.title: Ant-Man
episodes.description: Armed with the astonishing ability to shrink in scale but increase in strength, master thief Scott Lang must embrace his inner-hero and help his mentor, Doctor Hank Pym, protect the secret behind his spectacular Ant-Man suit from a new generation of towering threats. Against seemingly insurmountable obstacles, Pym and Lang must plan and pull off a heist that will save the world.

episodes.title: Bang
episodes.description: The New York City underworld is up for grabs after Wilson goes to jail. A new party arrives in town to kill all of the mobsters, and Daredevil goes after them.

episodes.title: Dogs to a Gunfight
episodes.description: Matt recovers from the Punisher's head shot, while Foggy and Karen arrange a deal with DA Samantha Reyes to get their client Grotto into WITSEC. However, Reyes needs Grotto to do one thing before she agrees.

episodes.title: New York's Finest
episodes.description: Punisher has a discussion with a captive Daredevil about what they do and why. Meanwhile, Reyes threatens to shut down Nelson & Murdoch, and Karen sets out to get something on the DA. At the hospital ER, Foggy turns to Claire for help locating a missing Matt.

episodes.title: Penny and Dime
episodes.description: An Irish mobster seeking revenge for Punisher killing his son--and the $1.2 million that Punisher stole--arrives in Hell's Kitchen. Meanwhile, Karen gets a lead on Frank Castle and investigates his connection to the homicidal vigilante prowling the city.

episodes.title: Kinbaku
episodes.description: While Matt deals with Elektra in the present, he remembers what happened between them ten years ago. Meanwhile, Blake pressures Foggy for information on the Grote case, and Karen digs into Frank's background when she suspects coverup.

episodes.title: Regrets Only
episodes.description: Elektra convinces Matt to let her help eliminate the Yakuza from New York City. Meanwhile, Nelson & Murdoch agree to enter a plea for Frank, and Karen learns more about their new client.

episodes.title: Semper Fidelis
episodes.description: Foggy tries to defend Frank in court, despite Matt's continuing absence as Daredevil teams up with Elektra to find out what the Japanese are up to.

episodes.title: Guilty as Sin
episodes.description: Foggy tries to mount Frank's legal defense despite Matt's ongoing absence. Meanwhile, Matt is reunited with an old friend and discovers his connection to Elektra... and the secret of the Hand.

episodes.title: Seven Minutes in Heaven
episodes.description: Wilson arranges for Frank to meet him in prison. Meanwhile, Foggy tries to keep the law firm afloat but discovers that Matt isn't interested.

episodes.title: The Man in the Box
episodes.description: People connected to the Central Park massacre are brutally gunned down, but Karen suspects that someone is setting Punisher up for a fall. Meanwhile, Matt convinces Claire to look after the Hand prisoners, but it turns out that they may not be as helpless as they appear.

Karen escapes her protective custody and meets with Frank, who is on the trail of Blacksmith. Meanwhile, Daredevil's own search for the elusive drug lord takes him to Madame Gao, who warns that his quest won't end well.

episodes.title: The Dark at the End of the Tunnel
episodes.description: After the Hand abduct Stick, Daredevil traces them to their lair beneath the city. Meanwhile, Karen continues her investigation into Frank's background after his death.

episodes.title: A Cold Day in Hell's Kitchen
episodes.description: Daredevil battles the Hand--with Elektra at his side--and discovers that the price of victory may prove too high to accept.

episodes.title: Moment of Truth
episodes.description: Luke tries to keep a low profile and pay his bills by working two jobs. However, he gets into trouble anyway when he has a one-nighter with a police detective, who is investigating an arms deal that local crime lord Cornell "Cottonmouth" Stokes was engineering.

episodes.title: Code of the Streets
episodes.description: Pop asks Luke for help finding Chico so that he can set up a parlay with Cornell to get his money back. However, Cornell's lieutenant Tone has other plans.

episodes.title: Who's Gonna Take the Weight?
episodes.description: After Pop's death, Luke sets out to take Cornell down by taking his money. However, both Cornell and Misty figure out that Luke is responsible.

episodes.title: Step in the Arena
episodes.description: As Luke fights for his life beneath a toppled building, he remembers his past and the experimental treatment at Seagate Prison that gave him his powers.

episodes.title: Just to Get a Rep
episodes.description: Cornell takes the battle to Luke when he tells his men to squeeze the people of Harlem for everything they have... and blame Luke. Meanwhile, Misty receives word that her partner Scarfe may be crooked.

episodes.title: Suckas Need Bodyguards
episodes.description: When Scarfe tries to hold up Cornell for more money, Cornell shoots him. Badly wounded, Scarfe turns to Luke for help and offers to give him the evidence that will put Cornell away for good.

episodes.title: Manifest
episodes.description: While Mariah faces pressure to resign, Cornell tries to blackmail Luke into working for him. In the past, Cornell and Mariah's history with Mama Mabel is revealed.

episodes.title: Blowin' Up the Spot
episodes.description: After Cornell's death, Mariah covers up her involvement with Shades' help and sets up Luke as the patsy. Meanwhile, Luke finds out Diamondback's true identity.

episodes.title: DWYCK
episodes.description: Stryker tightens his grip on Cornell's criminal empire, while Mariah plots to take advantage of Luke's attack on two cops to turn the public against him.

episodes.title: Take It Personal
episodes.description: After Claire and Burstein save his life, Luke learns some of what Reva was hiding from him. Meanwhile, Mariah tries to turn the people of Harlem against Luke as part of Stryker's scheme to sell his super-weapons.

episodes.title: Now You're Mine
episodes.description: When Luke busts into his club, Stryker turns the situation around and makes Luke look like the guilty party. Meanwhile, Misty's life is in danger and Claire is the only one who can help her.

episodes.title: Soliloquy of Chaos
episodes.description: After the events at the club, Stryker is forced to go on the run and orders Zip to eliminate Shades. Meanwhile, Luke gets a lead on Stryker's location and Mariah offers him what he needs to clear his name.

episodes.title: You Know My Steez
episodes.description: After a fierce battle with Stryker, Luke is taken into custody while Misty tries to arrest Mariah for the murder of her cousin Cornell.

episodes.title: Laws of Nature
episodes.description: Coulson and his team track down an outbreak of Inhumans and discover that someone is killing or capturing many of them... and it's not who they think. Meanwhile, Fitz takes desperate steps to recover Jemma, and Daisy and Mack ask Lincoln for help.

episodes.title: Purpose in the Machine
episodes.description: The team turn to Asgardian Elliott Randolph for help deciphering the monolith and rescuring Jemma. Meanwhile, Grant abducts a key player in his quest to rebuild Hydra, while Lance begins his quest to find--and kill--Grant.

episodes.title: A Wanted (Inhu)man
episodes.description: The ATCU launches a public alert to bring Lincoln in, and he reluctantly turns to Daisy for help when he realizes that he's in over his head. Meanwhile, Rosalind and Coulson negotiate a deal, and Lance and Melinda take the first step to infiltrating Hydra.

episodes.title: Devils You Know
episodes.description: S.H.I.E.L.D. and the ATCU get a lead on the mysterious Inhuman killer, Lash. Meanwhile, Lance prepares for a face-to-face meeting with Grant, and Melinda turns to Coulson and Andrew for help.

episodes.title: 4,722 Hours
episodes.description: Jemma tells Fitz how she survived on the alien planet for six and a half months... and who helped her.

episodes.title: Among Us Hide…
episodes.description: While Melinda recruits Bobbi to help her find Werner after his attack on Andrew, Lance joins Daisy and Mack to confirm if Rosalind's man Banks is the mysterious Lash. Meanwhiile, Fitz and Jemma continue to try and bring Will home.

episodes.title: Chaos Theory
episodes.description: Melinda realizes who--and what--Andrew really is and confronts him. Meanwhile, Coulson has Daisy give Rosalind a tour of the Zephyr, and Lincoln reaches out to Mack for help.

episodes.title: Snow Gives Way
episodes.description: A man claiming to be Danny Rand shows up at Rand Enterprises... 15 years after Danny Rand and his parents died in a plane crash over the Himalayas. The current owners, Joy and Ward Meacham, are skeptical of the man's claims.

episodes.title: Shadow Hawk Takes Flight
episodes.description: While Danny deals with life in a psychiatric hospital, Ward tries to bribe Colleen into signing papers that will let him commit Danny permanently. Meanwhile, Joy gets indisputable proof that Danny is who he claims.

episodes.title: Rolling Thunder Cannon Punch
episodes.description: Joy's loyalties are tested when she realizes that she holds the key to proving Danny's identity. Meanwhile, Harold receives a visitor and Colleen enters the ring as the Daughter of the Dragon.

episodes.title: Eight Diagram Dragon Palm
episodes.description: Harold orders Ward to drop the litigation keeping Danny from taking his rightful place at Rand Enterprises. Meanwhile, the Triads take it personally when Joy brokers the pier deal.

episodes.title: Under Leaf Pluck Lotus
episodes.description: Danny discovers that the Hand is shipping a new version of heroin into NYC using the pier. He recruits Colleen to help him find evidence and discovers the drug's creator instead.

episodes.title: Immortal Emerges from Cave
episodes.description: The Hand challenge Danny to a series of battle to determine the fate of their struggle. Meanwhile, Ward begins to lose his grip on reality, and Claire and Colleen get Radovan treatment.

episodes.title: Felling Tree with Roots
episodes.description: Joy suggests that Ward get treatment for his drug addiction. Meanwhile, Danny finds out more about the Hand's operation and convinces the Triad to help him attack it.

episodes.title: The Blessing of Many Fractures
episodes.description: Danny travels to China with Claire and Colleen to find the center of Gao's heroin operation, and faces an opponent unlike any he's ever fought. Meanwhile, Ward prepares to tell Joy that their father was still alive.

episodes.title: The Mistress of All Agonies
episodes.description: Gao tries to convince Danny and the others to let her go, while Colleen slowly succumbs to illness. Meanwhile, Ward discovers that Harold isn't as dead as he thought, and Joy learns the truth about the family secret.

episodes.title: Black Tiger Steals Heart
episodes.description: Danny wakes up at Bakuto's school and has a conversation with the imprisoned Gao. Meanwhile, an old friend comes to visit Danny, and Harold pays Lawrence a visit.

episodes.title: Lead Horse Back to Stable
episodes.description: Danny goes to Claire for treatment for the wound Bakuto left in his side. Meanwhile, Colleen swears to the Hand to find out where Danny is, and has her eyes opened to the truth.

episodes.title: Bar the Big Boss
episodes.description: Bakuto frees Ward from the psych hospital but demands a heavy price in return. Meanwhile, Danny must surrender himself to save the Meachums.

episodes.title: Dragon Plays with Fire
episodes.description: With the DEA after him, Danny has no choice but to take the fight to Harold and obtain the evidence that will clear his name.

episodes.title: Many Heads, One Tale
episodes.description: Having gained Rosalind's trust, Coulson distracts her with a tour of the base while the rest of the team breaks into the ATCU headquarters to learn about the Inhumans they have captured and their attempts at a cure. Meanwhile,Grant learns the true secret of Hydra.

episodes.title: Closure
episodes.description: After Grant strikes at Coulson through someone close to him, Coulson swears revenge and goes after the only thing that Grant cares about. Meanwhile, Mack takes command of S.H.I.E.L.D., and Jemma and Fitz are captured during a reconaissance mission.

episodes.title: Maveth
episodes.description: Mack and his team invade the Hydra castle in the hopes of bringing Fitz and Coulson back through the portal. Meanwhile, on the alien world Grant's team find Will and Fitz convinces him to lead them to the extraction point.

episodes.title: Bouncing Back
episodes.description: President Ellis sanctions Coulson to continue leading S.H.I.E.L.D. to deal with the Inhuman power. Meanwhile, Malick discovers that his new guest can speak, and Daisy's team encounters two new Inhumans in Bogota.

episodes.title: The Inside Man
episodes.description: Coulson and a reluctant Talbot attend an international symposium on the Inhumans, and discover a traitor in their midst. Meanwhile, the team meets Talbot's new bodyguard, who may provide a vaccine against Terrigenesis.

episodes.title: Parting Shot
episodes.description: A mission in Russia goes bad, and Bobbi and Lance are captured. To stop a coup and save S.H.I.E.L.D., the couple must make the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes.title: Watchdogs
episodes.description: A group calling themselves the Watchdogs vows to take out any Inhumans that they can find. They begin their campaign of terror by taking out an ATCu facility, but the team soon learn that the Watchdogs are a front for Hydra.

episodes.title: Spacetime
episodes.description: Daisy tries to stop a future that she foresees due to an Inhuman's power. Meanwhile, Hive gives Gideon a taste of true power, and Giyera chooses sides.

episodes.title: Paradise Lost
episodes.description: Hive calls a meeting of Hydra's inner circle to show them his true face... and to teach Gideon a lesson in loyalty. Meanwhile, Daisy and Lincoln contact a former Afterlife resident who has information on Hive, while the others investigate Hydra's newest purchase.

episodes.title: The Team
episodes.description: Daisy's secret warriors rescue Coulson and his people from Hydra. However, when they return to base with a captive Gideon, Coulson realizes that there may be a traitor among them.

episodes.title: The H Word
episodes.description: Matt, Jessica, Luke, and Danny try to get on with their lives. But the Hand has plans for New York City and won't tolerate interference.

episodes.title: Mean Right Hook
episodes.description: While tracking the people responsible for the tremor, Danny meets Luke and Matt meets Jessica. Meanwhile, the Hand finds a wall blocking their way but Alexandra realizes that it's door... and she knows where to find the key.

episodes.title: Worst Behavior
episodes.description: The four individual heroes all arrive at Midland Circle by different means, and Matt finds an old lover waiting for him.

episodes.title: Royal Dragon
episodes.description: The team takes refuge in a Chinese restaurant to regroup and exchange notes, but first Stick and then Alexandra find them.

episodes.title: Take Shelter
episodes.description: After one of their number is captured, three of the other Hand leaders consider if they are on the right path. Meanwhile, the team brings in their friends and loved ones to keep them safe from the Hand's retribution.

episodes.title: Ashes, Ashes
episodes.description: The team captures Danny to keep him safe, but Stick has other plans. Meanwhile, Elektra begins to remember her past, and Alexandra tries to quell a rebellion within the Hand's ranks.

episodes.title: Fish in the Jailhouse
episodes.description: The police hold Matt, Luke, and Jessica for questioning in the deaths of Stick and Sowande. Meanwhile, Elektra gives Danny the choice to help her freely in opening the wall.

episodes.title: The Defenders
episodes.description: The heroes assault Midland to rescue Danny and stop the Hand... but one of them will fall.

episodes.title: AVENGERS IMPACT: A WHIH Newsfront Special Report
episodes.description: The Avengers have saved our world... but at what cost? WHIH Newsfront returns with a special report. Join Christine Everhart and political correspondent Will Adams as they investigate "The World the Hero Leaves Behind."

episodes.title: WHIH Newsfront: The Cost of Saving the World
episodes.description: Join Christine Everhart and political correspondent Will Adams as they ask viewers who should be responsible for all of the cost associated with the clean up and rebuilding process.

episodes.title: The Singularity
episodes.description: While Coulson, Melinda, and Lincoln try to recover Daisy, Fitz, Jemma, and Mack go after a scientist who may hold the key to stopping Hive.

episodes.title: WHIH Newsfront: The Avengers and The White House
episodes.description: Join WHIH Newsfront as host Christine Everhart and political correspondent Will Adams debate the Avengers and the role that the White House and President Ellis should play.

episodes.title: Failed Experiments
episodes.description: Coulson sends a strike team to eliminate Hive before he poses a danger to the world. Meanwhile, Mack tries to save Daisy, and Lincoln insists on taking the anti-toxin that Fitz-Simmons has created to defeat Hive's parasites.

episodes.title: WHIH Newsfront Exclusive: President Ellis Discusses the Avengers
episodes.description: WHIH Newsfront lands an exclusive interview with President Ellis. Join Christine Everhart and political correspondent Will Adams ask him about nominating Thaddeus Ross as Secretary of State plus his thoughts on regulating the Avengers.

episodes.title: WHIH Breaking News: Attack in Lagos
episodes.description: WHIH Newsfront goes live with breaking news of an attack in Lagos, Nigeria. Reports of Avengers on the scene are among other details explored by Christine Everhart, political correspondent Will Adams, and field reporter Jackson Norris.

episodes.title: Captain America: Civil War
episodes.description: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.

episodes.title: Team Thor
episodes.description: This short satirical doc, directed by Taika Waititi (Marvel's Thor: Ragnarok), suggests what Thor might have been doing while the rest of the Avengers were battling each other in Marvel's Captain America: Civil War.

episodes.title: Team Thor: Part 2
episodes.description: See more of the hilarious partnership between Thor and his roommate Darryl in this satirical short.

episodes.title: Black Widow
episodes.description: Natasha Romanoff, also known as Black Widow, confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises. Pursued by a force that will stop at nothing to bring her down, Natasha must deal with her history as a spy and the broken relationships left in her wake long before she became an Avenger.

episodes.title: Black Panther
episodes.description: King T'Challa returns home to the reclusive, technologically advanced African nation of Wakanda to serve as his country's new leader. However, T'Challa soon finds that he is challenged for the throne by factions within his own country as well as without. Using powers reserved to Wakandan kings, T'Challa assumes the Black Panther mantle to join with ex-girlfriend Nakia, the queen-mother, his princess-kid sister, members of the Dora Milaje (the Wakandan 'special forces') and an American secret agent, to prevent Wakanda from being dragged into a world war.

episodes.title: Emancipation
episodes.description: After the Accords are passed, Coulson brings Talbot to the S.H.I.E.L.D. base to take inventory of their Inhumans. Meanwhile, Daisy helps Lincoln escape while Holden discovers the process to create Inhuman Primitives.

episodes.title: Absolution
episodes.description: S.H.I.E.L.D. manages to stop the missile launch and capture Hive... only to discover that he's exactly where he wants to be. Meanwhile, Daisy tries to deal with the guilt of what she's done.

episodes.title: Ascension
episodes.description: One of the team will have to sacrifice themselves to stop Hive from spreading the pathogen across the world.

episodes.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
episodes.description: Following the events of Captain America: Civil War, Peter Parker, with the help of his mentor Tony Stark, tries to balance his life as an ordinary high school student in Queens, New York City, with fighting crime as his superhero alter ego Spider-Man as a new threat, the Vulture, emerges.

episodes.title: 3AM
episodes.description: After he apparently dies, Frank tries to live peacefully but events overtake him. Meanwhile, an ICE agent tries to track down a U.S. military heroin ring.

episodes.title: Two Dead Men
episodes.description: The elusive whistleblower known as Micro contacts Frank, who tracks Micro back to the family that believes he's dead. Meanwhile, Karen does some research for Frank, and Dinah goes on a date with Billy Russo.

episodes.title: Kandahar
episodes.description: While Frank questions Micro about his intentions, he remembers what happened in Kandahar as part of Operation Cerberus.

episodes.title: Resupply
episodes.description: Frank goes after arms dealers, and discovers that Dinah and her team are after them as well. Meanwhile, Sarah gets a return visit from Frank, and Dinah gets a visit from her mentor.

episodes.title: Gunner
episodes.description: Frank and Micro track down Gunner, and Frank goes to see his old friend and learn if he knows who Agent Orange is. Meanwhile, Dinah lies under oath to cover up Frank's involvement,and Karen reaches out to Frank after Dinah interviews her.

episodes.title: The Judas Goat
episodes.description: After Frank is injured, Micro turns to Curtis for help. Meanwhile, Dinah asks Billy if he knows that Frank is alive, and Lewis learns where O'Connor served.

episodes.title: Crosshairs
episodes.description: Clay tries to give his son Lewis some advice. Meanwhile, Frank attacks Bennett but it's a ruse to get Bennett to lead them to Agent Orange.

episodes.title: Cold Steel
episodes.description: After paying his mother a visit, Billy tells Dinah about his childhood. Meanwhile, Dinah sets a trap for the person who has bugged her office, while Micro and Frank discuss strategy.

episodes.title: Front Toward Enemy
episodes.description: Lewis declares war on the government and anyone who supports it, and sends his manifesto to Karen. Meanwhile, Dinah considers what to say at Sam's service, or whether she should say anything at all.

episodes.title: Virtue of the Vicious
episodes.description: Lewis goes after Ori and Frank tries to stop him. Afterward, Detective Sergeant Mahoney tries to piece together what happened. Meanwhile, Dinah tells Hernandez what really happened that got Sam and the others killed.

episodes.title: Danger Close
episodes.description: Billy captures Sarah and Zach, and sends a squad of mercenaries to the power station. Frank is waiting. Meanwhile, Dinah meets with Billy and then Marion.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.description: Frank gives Dinah what she wants, and she learns that he murdered her former partner. Meanwhile, Micro and Frank make a deal to get Sarah and Zach back, but one of them is killed in the process.

episodes.title: Memento Mori
episodes.description: Billy escapes capture and takes hostages to force Frank to come to him for a final showdown.

episodes.title: Doctor Strange
episodes.description: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.

episodes.title: Vendetta
episodes.description: Yo-Yo and Daisy share a secret about Yo-Yo's past.

episodes.title: John Hancock
episodes.description: Yo-Yo meets Mace while signing the Sokovia Accords.

episodes.title: Progress
episodes.description: Yo-Yo runs into her teammates in her search for Ramon.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.description: May accuses Yo-Yo of stealing Mace's credentials.

episodes.title: Deal Breaker
episodes.description: Yo-Yo gets some unexpected help against Ramon.

episodes.title: Justicia
episodes.description: Yo-Yo attempts to complete her mission of vengeance.

episodes.title: The Ghost
episodes.description: After the Sokovia Accords, S.H.I.E.L.D. is under new management. Jemma is advising the new Director, Coulson and Mack are in the field, Melinda is training an elite strike force, and Daisy has gone rogue taking down Watchdog resources. She comes across a mysterious serial killer known as "Ghost Rider" who is apparently the Spirit of Vengeance.... and will stop at nothing to get his grisly revenge.

episodes.title: Meet the New Boss
episodes.description: Daisy tracks down Robbie and demands answers. Meanwhile, Fitz and Mack get a lead on the ghost that emerged from the box, and discover that there are more than one.

episodes.title: Uprising
episodes.description: A group claiming to be the Inhumans Resistance launches a series of blackouts across the globe. Jeffrey suspects something more is going on and sends Coulson, Mack, and Fitz to investigate. Meanwhile, Daisy learns more about Robbie and his brother Gabe, and Jemma and Holden struggle to save Melinda's life.

episodes.title: Let Me Stand Next to Your Fire
episodes.description: Daisy turns to Jemma for help, while Mack and Coulson pay a visit to Robbie's uncle Eli and encounter Ghost Rider. Meanwhile, Holden and Fitz use Melinda to test to see if Aida can pass as human.

episodes.title: Lockup
episodes.description: Coulson and his people break into prison to free Eli before Lucy finds him. Meanwhile, Jeffrey goes before the nation to debate Senator Nadeer about the Inhuman issue.

episodes.title: The Good Samaritan
episodes.description: How Robbie became Ghost Rider is revealed, after Jeffrey boards the Quinjet looking for Robbie and Daisy. Meanwhile, Lucy forces Eli to reveal the secrets of the Darkhold.

episodes.title: Deals with Our Devils
episodes.description: Coulson, Fitz, and Robbie disappear and their teammates assume that they're dead... unaware that they're out of phase, intangible, and invisible. Meanwhile, Mack loses hope and the vengeance demon seeks a now host.

episodes.title: The Laws of Inferno Dynamics
episodes.description: When Eli creates a nuclear bomb using his new powers, Fitz realizes where he is getting his energies from... and that they threaten to destroy LA. The team has to take Eli down before it's too late, but Eli manages to take Ghost Rider out of commission.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.description: Six teenagers, who were friends but broke up after the death of their friend Amy, come back together and discover that their parents aren't who they thought they were.

episodes.title: Rewind
episodes.description: On the day that the teenagers find out what their parents are doing, Geoffrey deals with a threat to his power, Victor tries to perfect the box, Tina uses her magic staff to seal Amy's room, Frank ask Leslie for more influence in the Church, and Stacey makes brie.

episodes.title: Destiny
episodes.description: After the events of the previous night, the teens split up to find evidence confirming their suspicions. Nico finds Tina's staff, and Gert and Chase find the dinosaur in the Yorkes' basement. Meanwhile, Catherine questions Molly about whether she was in Geoffrey's study or not.

episodes.title: Fifteen
episodes.description: Victor tries to make up for his screw-up, while Gert and Karolina team up to prove their parents' innocence. Meanwhile, Nico prepares to go to the police and asks Alex to go with her.

episodes.title: Kingdom
episodes.description: The teens chase after the abducted Alex and reveal their powers to each other. Meanwhile, Geoffrey avoids telling Catherine about Darius, and the parents get a new sacrifice.

episodes.title: Metamorphosis
episodes.description: Jonah insists on attending the PRIDE gala at the Wizard Building, where the teens try to obtain the video evidence showing that their parents killed Andre and the others.

episodes.title: Refraction
episodes.description: Jonah tells Leslie to bring PRIDE back together, but is unaware that Frank has learned part of the secret that Leslie is concealing. Meanwhile, Victor starts to revert to his old self as Jonah's treatment wears off, and Catherine tells the Yorkes what to do with Molly.

episodes.title: Tsunami
episodes.description: Alex tells Nico more about Amy's apparent suicide. Meanwhile, PRIDE argues about how to bring Victor back to life, and Jonah gives them an ultimatum.

episodes.title: Doomsday
episodes.description: The teens come together to stop their parents' plan to unleash a holocaust on LA.

episodes.title: Hostile
episodes.description: After Jonah captures Karolina, the teens go on the run and then regroup to rescue their friend.

episodes.title: Broken Promises
episodes.description: Jemma confirms Vijay's identity, and she, Jeffrey, and Daisy go to rescue him from his sister and the Watchdogs. Meanwhile, Aida attacks S.H.I.E.L.D. HQ in an attempt to obtain the Darkhold.

episodes.title: The Patriot
episodes.description: After an attempt on Jeffrey's life, Coulson and Mack escort him to safety... and discover the secret of his Inhuman abilities. Meanwhile, Fitz promises the decapitated Aida that he'll try to restore her, and Melinda wakes up in Holden's apartment.

episodes.title: Wake Up
episodes.description: Coulson authorizes a mission to bug Nadeer's office against Talbot's advice, but things go bad. Meanwhile, Holden finds the key to keeping Melinda imprisoned, and Fitz finds out what his friend is up to.

episodes.title: Hot Potato Soup
episodes.description: The Superior and his men abduct Billy Koenig to get the location of the Darkhold from him. While Coulson and his field team go after Sam, Fitz, Jemma, and Mack deal with the Holden LMD that they captured.

episodes.title: BOOM
episodes.description: The Superior sends Terrence to trigger Terragenesis in Nadeer, believing that she's an Inhuman. However, they all got an explosive surprise. Meanwhile, Coulson and Mack track down the woman that Aida's appearance was based on and try to use her to find Melinda.

episodes.title: The Man Behind the Shield
episodes.description: The team follows a series of clues left by the Superior designed to bring them to their opponent's base... and the trap that he's set for them.

episodes.title: Self Control
episodes.description: Fitz and Jemma realize that they may be the only senior staff that haven't been replaced with LMDs. Meanwhile, Aida makes her own plans to protect the Framework.

episodes.title: First Light
episodes.description: As children, Tyrone Johnson and Tandy Bowen are at a lake when a Roxxon oil rig collapses and energy from it sweeps over them both. Years later, they each discover that they have superpowers, and come across each other once more.

episodes.title: Suicide Sprints
episodes.description: Tandy turns to Liam for help raising enough money to buy papers to get out of New Orleans. Meanwhile, Tyrone questions seeking revenge on the man who killed his brother.

episodes.title: Stained Glass
episodes.description: While Tyrone turns to a voodoo priestess for help and receives visions of Tandy, Tandy has visions of Tyrone due to a concussion.

episodes.title: Call/Response
episodes.description: Tandy and Tyrone have a heart-to-heart at the church and test how their powers work. Meanwhile, Tyrone sees another side of his father while Tandy sees another side of her mother's boyfriend Greg.

episodes.title: Princeton Offense
episodes.description: Tandy uses her newfound powers to infiltrate a Roxxon charity gala and learn who the mystery man at the company is. Meanwhile, Tyrone plays in the state championship and discovers that his powers are running out of control. At the station, Brigid comes up with a risky scheme to determine Connors' involvement with the New Orleans drug business.

episodes.title: Funhouse Mirrors
episodes.description: Tyrone gets a lead on someone who saw his brother die. Meanwhile, Tandy befriends the daughter of her father Nathan's partner, while Connors suspects Brigid and takes steps to eliminate her as a threat.

episodes.title: Lotus Eaters
episodes.description: Tandy asks Tyrone to help her enter Ivan's catatonic mind and free him. However, the two of them are soon trapped in an endless loop of the oil rig's last moments before the explosion.

episodes.title: Ghost Stories
episodes.description: On the eighth anniversary of the oil rig explosion, Melissa and Tandy prepare to remember Nathan's death. Meanwhile, Tyrone uses the anniversary to try and scare Connors into confessing to Billy's murder.

episodes.title: Back Breaker
episodes.description: In the aftermath of the discoveries about their families, Tandy feeds on the hopes she sees, and Tyrone has a fateful encounter with Delgado. Meanwhile, Brigid attends Fuchs' wake and discovers that Connors holds a grudge.

episodes.title: Colony Collapse
episodes.description: New Orleans hovers on the edge of destruction as Terrors roam the street. Only Tyrone and Tandy can save it... but to do so, one of them must die.

episodes.title: Gimme Shelter
episodes.description: The kids take refuge on the streets after their parents have the police come after them. After Chase's Fistigons and the group's money is stolen, Alex goes back to Darius for cash but has to repay him with a favor. While chasing the Fistigon thief, the Runaways find a new hideout.

episodes.title: Radio On
episodes.description: While Nico, Karolina, and Molly go to get the Staff of One from Tina, Chase tries to power up the Hostel and discuss their relationship with Gert. Meanwhile, Alex goes back to help Darius and get closer to Livvie.

episodes.title: Double Zeros
episodes.description: Darius sets up Alex for betrayal, while Janet turns to James for help deciphering the Abstract. Meanwhile, the Runaways try to practice as a team but find themselves at odds without Alex there.

episodes.title: Old School
episodes.description: The Runaways are suspicious of Topher, and he tries to prove himself by helping them break into Atlas Academy to get a computer processor that Alex needs. Meanwhile, Gert risks exposing the group to get her anxiety meds, the Yorkes try to determine if their serum against Jonah will work, and Jonah takes Karolina to find out about herself.

episodes.title: Rock Bottom
episodes.description: While the Runaways deal with revelations about Topher's life and his addiction to the rocks, Frank and Leslie disagree about Jonah's interference in Karolina's life and Gert goes to extreme measure to get medication for her anxiety.

episodes.title: Bury Another
episodes.description: After Robert's failed attempt to kill Jonah, the Deans tell Jonah that he'll have to get his own sacrifice. Meanwhile, rifts open up between Chase and Gert, and Nico and Karolina.

episodes.title: Last Rites
episodes.description: The Runaways head to the site to stop the lift-off of Jonah's spaceship. PRIDE has their own plans, but the two sides must join forces if they have any hope of stopping the destruction of California.

episodes.title: Past Life
episodes.description: After Jonah is apparently killed, PRIDE breaks up. Frank turns to Leslie for help, Geoffrey discovers that he has a new enemy, and the Runaways break into a hotel penthouse so that Alex can get evidence showing who killed Darius.

episodes.title: Big Shot
episodes.description: Tina and Stacey start acting strangely as PRIDE realizes that they still need each other despite Jonah's death. Meanwhile, Gert and Old Lace get increasingly sick, and Karolina hears a mysterious voice in the Hostel calling to her.

episodes.title: Hostile Takeover
episodes.description: While AWOL and his men lay siege to the Hostel, Gert and Old Lace's condition worsens and Chase turns to an unexpected source for help. Meanwhile, Leslie tries to dismantle the Church and meets surprising resistance.

episodes.title: Last Waltz
episodes.description: After Gert and Chase escape the Yorkes, the Runaways decide to celebrate Molly's 15th birthday. However, Chase has plans of his own for afterward.

episodes.title: Earth Angel
episodes.description: While Victor tries to demonstrate to Chase that PRIDE has changed its ways, Frank takes Karolina prisoner at the Crater and Susan has a change of heart.

episodes.title: Split Up
episodes.description: On behalf of PRIDE, Chase gives the Runaways one last chance to come in. When they refuse, their parents come after them and the group is forced to split up... and not everyone makes it back to the Hostel.

episodes.title: What If...
episodes.description: Jemma and Daisy discover that things have gone horribly wrong in the Framework, when they realize that Hydra now rules the world and ruthlessly hunts down and exterminates Inhumans.

episodes.title: Identity and Change
episodes.description: While Daisy tries to get Holden's location via Hydra's databases, Coulson and Jemma meet with the head of the resistance. Meanwhile, Aida tells Fitz her version of the truth about the Framework.

episodes.title: No Regrets
episodes.description: Coulson and Jeffrey break into an Enlightenment Center to rescue a prisoner with valuable information about Project Looking Glass. Meanwhile, Fitz meets with an unexpected ally, and Jemma tries to convince Grant and Jeffrey that their world isn't real.

episodes.title: All the Madame's Men
episodes.description: Daisy and Melinda escape the Triskelion and go on the run from Hydra. Meanwhile, Jemma realizes what Aida has planned, and Holden tells Alistair who he is in the real world.

episodes.title: Farewell, Cruel World!
episodes.description: Daisy and Jemma take the team to the backdoor, only to discover that Aida has anticipated them. Meanwhile, Fitz discovers that his father is dead and who is responsible, and sets out to exact vengeance.

episodes.title: The Return
episodes.description: While Coulson and Melinda try to escape the rig, Jemma and Daisy find themselves under attack. Meanwhile, Aida revels in the joys of becoming human.

episodes.title: World's End
episodes.description: Aida sets out to destroy the world with the help of the Darkhold, and only Ghost Rider can stop her. Meanwhile, S.H.I.E.L.D. is framed for weaponizing the Inhumans and the authorities close in on the team.

episodes.title: Restless Energy
episodes.description: Tyrone and Tandy deal with the aftermath of saving New Orleans: Tyrone is forced to keep a low profile because he's wanted for killing a cop, and Tandy takes ballet classes and adjusts to a normal life with her mother Melissa. Meanwhile, Brigid finds herself stressed out after the events of the last year.

episodes.title: White Lines
episodes.description: Tyrone tries to identify the symbol that he and Tandy found at the club, while Tandy helps an abused woman. The teenagers' paths cross again when Tyrone discovers that the woman has been abducted and given heroin. Meanwhile, Brigid faces the dark side of herself.

episodes.title: Shadow Selves
episodes.description: Tandy, Tyrone, and Brigid learn the origin of the second Brigid, aka Mayhem, and try to stop her as she searches for the missing girls... using any means necessary, no matter how violent.

episodes.title: Rabbit Hold
episodes.description: Tandy frightens Tyrone into creating a portal so she can enter the darkness and pull out Mayhem and Connors. Tyrone then pays Adina a visit.

episodes.title: Alignment Chart
episodes.description: While Tyrone finds Connors while trying to clear his name, Tandy sets out to help the women abducted by the human traffickers and makes an unexpected connection with her group therapist.

episodes.title: B Sides
episodes.description: Tandy finds herself moving from life to life, and the only constant in each one is that Tyrone is at her side... until he isn't.

episodes.title: Vikingtown Sound
episodes.description: Adina tries to get closure with Connors, while Tyrone searches for Tandy. Andre takes away Tandy's hope and then goes seeking answers from Chantelle.

episodes.title: Two Player
episodes.description: Tandy enters the darkness within Tyrone to bring him back to the real world. Adina finds Delgado and asks him to hear her confession. Brigid and Mayhem come to an understanding.

episodes.title: Blue Note
episodes.description: Tyrone and Tandy both try to track down Andre, who plans to become a god when he hits the blue note.

episodes.title: Level Up
episodes.description: Andre forces Tyrone and Tandy to face their inner demons made flesh, while Mayhem protects Evita, who has opened a portal so that the heroes can take the fight to Andre.

episodes.title: Smoke and Mirrors
episodes.description: Alex and Nico break into the Stein manor to rescue their friends, while Xavin and Molly lure the Magister and his family away. Dale reveals a new side to Gert's link to Old Lace, and Leslie learns more about the child she's carrying.

episodes.title: The Great Escape
episodes.description: Janet tries to reunite Chase and Karolina with her in the Algorithm, while Alex tries to free them from the outside using the Abstract. Stacey pays a visit to Dale and Gert, and Xavin warns that the Runaways are still in danger.

episodes.title: Lord of Lies
episodes.description: The Runaways suspect that the Son is among them. Leslie reaches out to her mother for advice, and Tina tests the portal.

episodes.title: Rite of Thunder
episodes.description: Alex abducts Leslie as she goes into labor, and takes her to the one place where he thinks she'll be safe. Meanwhile, the Runaways prepare for final battle against the Gibborim family as the latter prepare to return to their home planet.

episodes.title: Enter the Dreamland
episodes.description: The Runaways find themselves in the Dark Dimension, and set out to find their missing parents and Alex... before they lose their memories of their past lives.

episodes.title: Merry Meet Again
episodes.description: After six months in the Dark Dimension, the Runaways return to LA and discover that a new phone fad has swept the city. Robert has a new girlfriend, Molly and Gert get new men in their lives, and Dale becomes part of the unwashed masses. Stacey and Victor go to an alien survivors' group meeting and then Victor offers Stacey a job.

episodes.title: Left-Hand Path
episodes.description: Morgan thwarts the Runaways from warning the public about the Wizphones' influence. Geoffrey reveals his new allegiance, Molly reveals her powers to Bodhi, and Nico goes her own path to try and bring Alex back.

episodes.title: Devil's Torture Chamber
episodes.description: Tawny and Tyrone arrive at the Hostel to investigate a disturbance in the Dark Dimension, and accompany Nico, Karolina, Gert, and Chase on a mission to rescue Alex.

episodes.title: The Broken Circle
episodes.description: The remaining PRIDE parents help rescue Molly, and then help the Runaways find a way to contain Morgan once and for all.

episodes.title: Cheat the Gallows
episodes.description: In 2022, Chase travels back to try and prevent Alex from killing their past selves... and ends up trying to keep Morgan from killing Gert.

episodes.title: AKA Start at the Beginning
episodes.description: Jessica is drowning her guilt over killing Killgrave in alcohol and meaningless cases. Trish insists on digging up Jessica's past to learn more about IGH, and a client who IGH experimented on comes to Jessica asking for help. Meanwhile, Jeri gets some disturbing news and a rival detective firm offers to buy Alias Investigations out.

episodes.title: AKA Freak Accident
episodes.description: While Jessica tries to find Whizzer's killer, Trish conducts her own investigation and recruits Malcolm to help her. Meanwhile, Jeri deals with her medical condition in her own unique way.

episodes.title: AKA Sole Survivor
episodes.description: Jessica gets a lead on the doctor who sent her to IGH, but the confrontation doesn't go as expected. Meanwhile, Trish chafes at Jessica's attempts to protect her, and Malcolm meets with the landlord to figure out why he's letting Oscar force Jessica to leave.

episodes.title: AKA God Help the Hobo
episodes.description: Jessica and Trish try to track down the third IGH patient. Meanwhile, Pryce makes Malcolm an offer, and Jeri gives her doctor an ultimatum.

episodes.title: AKA The Octopus
episodes.description: On Jeri's advice, Jessica comes clean with the cops. She then gets Oscar to help her get in to see the man who supposedly killed Luanne. Meanwhile, Trish gets an unexpected proposal.

episodes.title: AKA Facetime
episodes.description: Jessica continues her search for Malus and the mystery woman. Meanwhile, Trish starts to go through drug withdrawal, Malcolm confronts his past, and Inez confronts Jeri over her ALS.

episodes.title: AKA I Want Your Cray Cray
episodes.description: Alisa tells Jessica how she ended up with IGH, and how she was once a part of Jessica's life.

episodes.title: AKA Ain't We Got Fun
episodes.description: Jessica and Alisa sit down for a heart-to-heart, while Trish tells Malcolm what she's been doing with the inhaler.

episodes.title: AKA Shark in the Bathtub, Monster in the Bed
episodes.description: When Jessica discovers who the shooter is, Alisa wants to kill him but her daughter has other plans. Meanwhile, Jeri blackmails Shane into helping her, and Trish gets a surprising offer.

episodes.title: AKA Pork Chop
episodes.description: Jessica tries to convince Alisa to confess and give up Malus' location in return for the chance to spend time with her. Meanwhile, Trish convinces Malcolm to help her find Malus, and Jessica discovers that Inez and Shane aren't what they seem.

episodes.title: AKA Three Lives and Counting
episodes.description: After accidentally killing Dale, Jessica hallucinates Kilgrave coming to see her... and encouraging her to kill again. Meanwhile, Trish convinces Malus to provide her with his special treatment.

episodes.title: AKA Pray for My Patsy
episodes.description: Alisa kills a police detective while trying to get to Trish, and her partner orders Jessica to let the police handle it. Meanwhile, Jeri plots her revenge against Shane and Inez.

episodes.title: AKA Playland
episodes.description: Jessica finds herself on the run with her mother, and they make plans to leave the country. Meanwhile, Dorothy take charges of Trish's recovery, and Malcolm finishes his first case.

episodes.title: Behold... The Inhumans
episodes.description: On the moon, the original Inhumans take refuge in the city of Attilan. However, their growing population threatens to exceed their resources, and the powerless Maximus advocates a stronger stance against humans. When his brother, King Black Bolt, refuses, Maximus leads a coup that scatters the Royal Family in four different locales in Hawaii.

episodes.title: Those Who Would Destroy Us
episodes.description: Louise travels to Hawaii to investigate the mysterious teleportation glitches from the moon to the earth. Meanwhile, Black Bolt is arrested, Gorgon makes friends, Medusa catches a bus, Karnak's power falters, and Maximus tries to recruit Crystal to his side.

episodes.title: Divide and Conquer
episodes.description: Black Bolt meets a fellow Inhuman in prison. Meanwhile, begining to acclimate to human life, Gorgon and his new allies face Auran and her hunter squad, and Karnak continues losing his abilities.

episodes.title: Make Way for... Medusa
episodes.description: Medusa continues her search for Black Bolt. Meanwhile, Gorgon goes to find Karnak, Lockjaw gets medical treatment, and Maximus banishes the Genetic Council when they refuse to heed his commands.

episodes.title: Something Inhuman This Way Comes
episodes.description: When Karnak helps Jen against Reno, she's badly wounded. The Inhuman has no choice but to turn and fight despite his lack of powers. Meanwhile, Gorgon searches for his cousin, and Auran takes Evan and Sammy hostage to force Black Bolt to return to them.

episodes.title: The Gentleman's Name Is Gorgon
episodes.description: Black Bolt sends Karnak and Gorgon to save Evan and Sammy from Auran and her people, but things go horribly wrong. Meanwhile, Audrey betrays Dave and Crystal to the police, and Maximus finds a traitor among his people.

episodes.title: Havoc in the Hidden Land
episodes.description: The Royal Family returns to Attilan, but Black Bolt and Medusa disagree on how to deal with Maximus. Meanwhile, Karnak makes a deal with Auran to try and bring Gorgon back from the dead, and Maximus and Evan meet face-to-face for the first time.

episodes.title: ... And Finally: Black Bolt
episodes.description: The Royals return to Attilan to try to prevent the city's destruction, only to discover that they're too late. Meanwhile, Medusa tries to get through to Maximus, and Karnak tries to get through to Gorgon.

episodes.title: Soul Brother #1
episodes.description: Luke takes on heroin dealers branding their product with his name, and finds himself becoming increasingly famous. Meanwhile, Misty returns to work after losing her arm, and a new player enters Harlem.

episodes.title: Straighten It Out
episodes.description: Mariah tries to rebuild her reputation by rebuilding her relationship with her daughter; Luke and Shades lose their tempers; Claire worries about Luke.

episodes.title: Wig Out
