episodes.description: Luke lashes out at Misty and Claire. Misty turns to a friend to deal with her anger, while Claire pays a visit to father James.

episodes.title: I Get Physical
episodes.description: Luke teams up with Misty to check on the Yardies, but discovers that they have moved on. Meanwhile, Bushmaster confronts Mariah, Misty gets an invitation from Danny and Colleen, and Bobby gets a call from his daughter.

episodes.title: All Souled Out
episodes.description: While Mariah tells Tilda the truth about the family business, Luke entertains at a party and Misty considers the case against Cockroach.

episodes.title: The Basement
episodes.description: Luke takes refuges with Piranha to keep Bushmaster from acquiring the money man. Meanwhile, Shades and Comanche discuss old times, and Misty contemplates her future with the department.

episodes.title: On and On
episodes.description: Misty hands in her resignation, while Shades discovers who the snitch is in Mariah's organization.

episodes.title: If It Ain't Rough, It Ain't Right
episodes.description: In the aftermath of the brownstone fire, Bushmaster puts a price on Mariah's head... and the heads of anyone connected to Luke.

episodes.title: For Pete's Sake
episodes.description: Luke and Misty take their group into hiding at a Rand facility under construction. While they try to negotiate an immunity deal for Mariah, Bushmaster learns where they are thanks to his snitch in the department.

episodes.title: The Main Ingredient
episodes.description: Danny--the Immortal Iron Fist--pays Luke a visit and offers to help him find Bushmaster. Meanwhile, Mariah regains her stolen forms and Misty confronts the traitor in the precinct house.

episodes.title: The Creator
episodes.description: Luke finds the only survivor of the restaurant massacre and tries to persuade her to testify against Mariah. Meanwhile, Bushmaster remembers his childhood while fighting for his life with Tilda's help.

episodes.title: Can't Front on Me
episodes.description: After arranging a drug distribution deal with the Chinese, Mariah distributes "Bushmaster heroin" throughout Harlem in an attempt do draw her rival out. She also throws a charity jam, well aware that Luke will come to protect the innocents when Bushmaster attacks her.

episodes.title: They Reminisce Over You
episodes.description: Hell breaks in loose in Harlem after Mariah goes to prison, and Luke attempts to broker a peace with the warring crime families.

episodes.title: The Fury of Iron Fist
episodes.description: Danny battles the Triads and the gangs as they move into the power void left by the Hand's disappearance. Meanwhile, Joy demands her share of Rand Enterprise while concealing her alliance with Davos.

episodes.title: The City's Not for Burning
episodes.description: While Danny and Colleen struggle to stop a war between the Triads that will devastate Chinatown, Davos struggles with his principles and Ward struggles to decipher Joy's scheme.

episodes.title: This Deadly Secret...
episodes.description: Danny and Colleen invite Joy and Davos over for dinner. Meanwhile, the Triad war in Chinatown heats up and Colleen gets more information about the man who donated her family heirloom.

episodes.title: Target: Iron Fist
episodes.description: Joy questions Mary about why Mary's plan seems to be failing. Meanwhile, Davos gets what he always wanted, and an old friend pays Danny and Colleen a visit.

episodes.title: Heart of the Dragon
episodes.description: A gang captures Danny and Danny discovers that he no longer has the Fist. Misty and Colleen pay Joy a visit and meet Mary, and Danny and Ward have a heart-to-heart.

episodes.title: The Dragon Dies at Dawn
episodes.description: While Misty and Colleen look for the Crane sisters, Danny makes a deal with Walker, and Ward and Joy discuss their past.

episodes.title: Morning of the Mindstorm
episodes.description: Danny recovers from Davos' crippling strike, while Ward learns a secret about Bethany. Meanwhile, Joy meets with Mary and then seeks a reconciliation with Davos.

episodes.title: Citadel on the Edge of Vengeance
episodes.description: Colleen seeks to train Danny not just physically but emotionally for his upcoming rematch with Davos. Meanwhile, Joy offers Davos some advice and then makes a call to Ward.

episodes.title: War Without End
episodes.description: Colleen comes to a decision concerning the Fist, but her choice may be irrelevant when Davos wakes up prematurely. Meanwhile, Ward and Walker go to rescue Joy, unaware that Misty has the same thing in mind.

episodes.title: A Duel of Iron
episodes.description: Davos fights to keep the Fist, but his opponent isn't who he expected. Walker asks Joy for a favor, and Ward and Danny go on a trip together.

episodes.title: Orientation (Part One)
episodes.description: The team finds themselves on a mysterious outpost in space surrounded by corpses, and with no sign of Fitz. As they meet the inhabitants, the agents try to work out where they are.

episodes.title: Orientation (Part Two)
episodes.description: As they come to their grips with their new surroundings, Coulson, Mack, and Elena are forced to make a deal with a crime lord, Grill. Meanwhile, Jemma is captured by the Kree, and Daisy discovers who was responsible for Earth's fate.

episodes.title: A Life Spent
episodes.description: While Daisy tries to rescue Jemma, Coulson and his team search the rubble belt for a mysterious segment. Meanwhile, Jemma coaches a young Inhuman in her powers.

episodes.title: A Life Earned
episodes.description: Kasius tells Daisy what her value is to him. Meanwhile, Grill tasks Mack with acting as his new enforcer, and Coulson and Melinda discover that Deke isn't being honest with them.

episodes.title: Rewind
episodes.description: Fitz is left behind and the military locks him up. He soon plots an escape, and works out a way to travel to the future to rescue his friends.

episodes.title: Fun & Games
episodes.description: Fitz makes contact with Jemma and tries to plan an escape. Meanwhile, the human teenagers undergo Terrigenesis and one of them reveals his new power.

episodes.title: Together or Not at All
episodes.description: Faulnak sends his best hunter to recover Daisy, while Daisy, Fitz, and Jemma try to reunite with Coulson and the others. On the surface, Melinda meets Enoch.

episodes.title: The Last Day
episodes.description: Coulson and the others meet up with the surface survivors, while Mack, Elena, and Flint battle the Roaches that Kasius has unleashed on the Lighthouse humans.

episodes.title: Best Laid Plans
episodes.description: While Elena and Mack rally the humans to fight against Kasius, Coulson and the others try to find a way to return to the Lighthouse while Sinara comes looking for Daisy.

episodes.title: Past Life
episodes.description: As Deke and Enoch prepare to open the time portal, Elena discovers who Kasius' Seer is while Daisy refuses to go back to 2018 and end up destroying the planet.

episodes.title: Resurrection
episodes.description: In the aftermath of the battle with the Hand, Matt loses part of his hearing and heals with the aid of the nuns at the orphanage where he grew up. Meanwhile, Foggy and Karen try to move on with their lives, and an FBI agent reaches out to Fisk with surprising results.

episodes.title: Please
episodes.description: While Matt suffers a crisis of faith, Fisk finds himself the target of inmates trying to kill him because he's become a snitch.

episodes.title: No Good Deed
episodes.description: The FBI move Fisk to a $20 million hotel penthouse to protect him, but the public soon learns of it. Matt considers what to do next, while Karen learns of a connection between Fisk and the Kazimis.

episodes.title: Blindsided
episodes.description: Matt goes prison using Foggy's stolen bar card to get information on Fisk from the Albanians, while Foggy and Marci settle on the best way for Foggy to protect himself from Fisk.

episodes.title: The Perfect Game
episodes.description: Fisk analyzes Dex's past while looking for a scapegoat to take the public's eye off of him. Meanwhile, Ray questions Foggy and Karen about their involvement with CGI and Wesley's disappearance.

episodes.title: The Devil You Know
episodes.description: Fisk makes Dex an offer, while Foggy negotiates a deal with the FBI for Matt to turn himself in.... if they'll listen to an exonerating witness first.

episodes.title: Aftermath
episodes.description: Ray begins to suspect that Fisk has been playing him as well as the entire FBI. Meanwhile, Matt, Karen, and Foggy each deal with the aftermath of the Bulletin attack in their own way.

episodes.title: Upstairs/Downstairs
episodes.description: Dex reaches out to Julie but Fisk has other plans. Daredevil teams up with Ray to get the good on Dex, and Karen confront Fisk in his penthouse.

episodes.title: Revelations
episodes.description: While Matt takes in the news of who his mother is, Karen prepares to run, Foggy gets some bad news from his brother, and Fisk tightens his fist on the NYC underworld.

episodes.title: Karen
episodes.description: In the past, the reason behind Karen leaving home is revealed. In the present, Dex tracks Karen to the church and Daredevil tries to stop him.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.description: After the church slaughter, Ray has a decision to make and puts his family at risk. After Maggie gives him sanctuary, Matt meets with Karen and Foggy to decide on a plan of action against Fisk.

episodes.title: One Last Shot
episodes.description: Vanessa returns to NYC but Fisk realizes that something is bothering her. Meanwhile, Murdock & Nelson represent a new client, but Fisk has anticipated their strategem.

episodes.title: A New Napkin
episodes.description: As Fisk and Vanessa prepare for their wedding day, Daredevil makes a call to Dex that pushes him over the line.

episodes.title: Thor: Ragnarok
episodes.description: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his home-world and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of a powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.

episodes.title: Team Darryl
episodes.description: With Thor gone, Darryl begins the search for a new roommate. Unfortunately, only one person responds to his ad… the Grandmaster.

episodes.title: Roadhouse Blues
episodes.description: Frank stops at a roadhouse and makes a new friend, and soon gets involved in trouble when thugs come after a young girl who may or may not want his protection.

episodes.title: Fight or Flight
episodes.description: Frank and Amy end up in a motel room together, but the people after Amy get information on Frank from Beth and come after him. Meanwhile, Dinah pays Billy another visit in the hospital.

episodes.title: Trouble the Water
episodes.description: Pilgrim and his men launch an attack on the station to get Frank, and Frank tries to convince Sheriff Hardin to let him help.

episodes.title: Scar Tissue
episodes.description: Frank and Billy both visit some old associates, while Amy remembers some of the circumstances that put her on the run from Pilgrim.

episodes.title: One-Eyed Jacks
episodes.description: Frank sets out to find out more about Konchevsky, and uses Turk Barrett as bait. Billy makes a new friend, and Krista goes to the window.

episodes.title: Nakazat
episodes.description: Once Frank and Amy develop the photos, Frank goes after Poloznev. Billy goes after Curtis, and Mahoney goes after Dinay.

episodes.title: One Bad Day
episodes.description: Frank and Curtis close in on Billy, who is preparing for his first robbery.

episodes.title: My Brother's Keeper
episodes.description: Billy starts to remember the past after his encounter with Frank, and then makes an offer to the Boys. Curtis meets Amy for supper, and Frank pays a visit to his wife's grave.

episodes.title: Flustercluck
episodes.description: Following Anderson's orders, Pilgrim puts a bounty on Frank and Amy's head. Amy turns to a friend for help, while Frank continues looking for Billy... who is paying a visit to Dinah.

episodes.title: The Dark Hearts of Men
episodes.description: Frank goes after Billy, and Curtis and Pilgrim both end up with blood on their hands. Krista and Dinah talk about hells, and Krista realizes how Billy can break Frank.

episodes.title: The Abyss
episodes.description: While Frank lies in custody, Dinah teams up with Karen Page to find out what really happened at the warehouse.

episodes.title: Collision Course
episodes.description: Mahoney takes Frank for a ride, Pilgrim pays Curtis and Amy a visit, and Krista takes a fall for Billy.

episodes.title: The Whirlwind
episodes.description: When Pilgrim abducts Amy and demands David's return, Pilgrim and Frank meet in final combat.

episodes.title: All the Comforts of Home
episodes.description: Coulson and team return to 2018 and discover that they're fugitives from the government. A mysterious woman leads the government forces, and sets off a chain of events that may lead to the future that the team experienced.

episodes.title: The Real Deal
episodes.description: The team discovers what Coulson has been hiding from them, as the monoliths' explosion causes a rift to a fear dimension that threatens to destroy them all.

episodes.title: Principia
episodes.description: The team gets a lead on the Gravitonium they need to seal the rift once and for all. Meanwhile, Deke learns who his grandparents are, while Hale and Ruby recruit another member to their team.

episodes.title: The Devil Complex
episodes.description: Fitz tries to seal the rift, and what appears to be his greatest fear materializes to help him. Meanwhile, Coulson and Melinda capture Hale only to discover that it's a trap.

episodes.title: Rise and Shine
episodes.description: Hale's history with Hydra is revealed as she tries to convince Coulson to join forces with her. Meanwhile, Fitz asks for his freedom so that he can help find out why Hale wants their leader.

episodes.title: Inside Voices
episodes.description: Coulson convinces one of Hale's people to help him. Meanwhile, Jemma and Elena come up with a plan to free Fitz, while Daisy and Melinda turn to Robin for help.

episodes.title: The Honeymoon
episodes.description: Deke is injured trying to help Daisy, while Fitzsimmons and Elena discover what Hale has planned. Meanwhile, Melinda makes a confession to Coulson.

episodes.title: All Roads Lead…
episodes.description: Daisy benches Coulson and takes a team to stop Ruby before she becomes the Destroyer of Worlds.

episodes.title: A.K.A The Perfect Burger
episodes.description: Jessica picks up her mother's bad habit of hopefulness, and Dorothy hires her to find the missing Trish. Malcom has doubts about his job with Jeri, and Jeri reconnects with an old friend.

episodes.title: A.K.A You're Welcome
episodes.description: While Jessica tries to sort out her life, Trish hones her skills with her newfound powers and learns the trials and tribulations of becoming a superhero.

episodes.title: A.K.A I Have No Spleen
episodes.description: After getting Andrew's name from Trish and discharging herself from the hospital, Jessica goes after the person she believes is responsible for stabbing her. Jeri has lunch with Kith and then asks Malcolm to dig up some dirt on Kith's husband Peter.

episodes.title: A.K.A Customer Service is Standing By
episodes.description: Jessica goes with Erik to track down the three people that he was blackmailing, figuring that one of them attacked her while trying to get at him. Malcolm digs up dirt on Peter, but Jeri hesitates to use it.

episodes.title: A.K.A I Wish
episodes.description: Jessica teams up with Trish to bring down Gregory, and Gillian insists that the two of them have a heart-to-heart. After his secrets are revealed, Peter makes an Internet announcement that throws Jeri's life into turmoil.

episodes.title: A.K.A Sorry Face
episodes.description: Jessica and Trish try to find Erik before it's too late. Jeri takes bagels to Peter's wake, and Malcolm pays a visit to Berry's pimp.

episodes.title: A.K.A The Double Half-Wappinger
episodes.description: While Jessica and Trish travel to Gregory's home town to trace his career of serial killing, Malcolm is forced to choose between his job at the firm or helping Jessica.

episodes.title: A.K.A Camera Friendly
episodes.description: Gregory sends Jessica a self-erasing video promising to kill another victim and expose her as a fraud. As the clock ticks down, Jessica and Trish try to find the serial killer's next victim. Jeri declares war on supers, and Malcolm and Zaya have a fight over his helping Jessica.

episodes.title: A.K.A I Did Something Today
episodes.description: Gregory blackmails Jessica into destroying the evidence implicating him in Nathan's murder. Trish identifies Dorothy's body, and Laurent asks Jeri to help Kith.

episodes.title: A.K.A Hero Pants
episodes.description: Jessica and Trish make preparations for Dorothy's funeral. Berry asks Malcolm for a favor after he and Zaya have an argument, and the police investigate Jessica's involvement with Carl's death.

episodes.title: A.K.A Hellcat
episodes.description: Trish remembers her childhood as she teams with Erik to take down evil and clear Jessica's name.

episodes.title: A.K.A A Lotta Worms
episodes.description: Jessica is forced to protect Gregory when Trish comes after him. After escaping her friend, Jessica falls into Gregory's clutches while Trish falls into Malcolm's hands.

episodes.title: A.K.A Everything
episodes.description: When it's clear Trish has gone too far and has no intention of stopping, Jessica goes after her friend before she can kill again.

episodes.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
episodes.description: Just when his time under house arrest is about to end, Scott Lang once again puts his freedom at risk to help Hope van Dyne and Dr. Hank Pym dive into the quantum realm and try to accomplish, against time and any chance of success, a very dangerous rescue mission.

episodes.title: Avengers: Infinity War
episodes.description: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.

episodes.title: Option Two
episodes.description: Qovas sends his men to get the Gravitonium, and finds a team torn apart by suspicion and distrust of each other... and no sign of Daisy.

episodes.title: The One Who Will Save Us All
episodes.description: Talbot and Coulson go to negotiate with the Confederacy, while Daisy has Jemma find a way to make the Centipede technology work.

episodes.title: The Force of Gravity
episodes.description: While Talbot pays his family a visit, Coulson and Melinda try to find a way off of the Confederacy spaceship.

episodes.title: The End
episodes.description: A member of the team dies while trying to stop Talbot, who is intent on acquiring enough Gravitonium to fight Thanos. Meanwhile, the agents try to deal with Coulson's impending death.

episodes.title: Missing Pieces
episodes.description: Daisy, Jemma, Piper, and Davis search the galaxy for Fitz. On Earth, Mac continues his command of S.H.I.E.L.D. as a series of dimensional anomalies spring up across the planet.

episodes.title: Window of Opportunity
episodes.description: Sarge and his crew seek out a vital component to their plan, and S.H.I.E.L.D. slowly learns of their intentions while pursuing them. Fitz's position as an engineer on the Sivian ship is threatened... along with his life.

episodes.title: Fear and Loathing on the Planet of Kitson
episodes.description: Daisy and her team track Fitz and Enoch to Kitson, where the unlikely duo have lost their ship and are trying to make enough money gambling to get off the planet.

episodes.title: Code Yellow
episodes.description: What Deke has been up to is revealed, and he discovers that Sarge and his crew are after him. Meanwhile, Keller is infected by an alien parasite and Yo-Yo and Marcus try to save his life.

episodes.title: The Other Thing
episodes.description: Sarge demonstrates to Miranda the magnitude of the threat Earth faces. Marcus gets a clue to the parasites' plans in Yucatan, and Enoch betrays his best friend.

episodes.title: Inescapable
episodes.description: Atarah traps Fitz and Jemma in a mind prison and the only way out is for them to find a way for the remaining Chronicoms to travel back through time and save their homeworld. But to do so, the couple must face their inner demons.

episodes.title: Toldja
episodes.description: Mack questions the captive Sarge, who has plans of his own. Fitz, Jemma, and Enoch return to Kitson and Mr. Kitson has words with them.

episodes.title: Collision Course (Part I)
episodes.description: Mack sends Melinda, Daisy, and Deke with Sarge and Snowflake, while he holds Jaco and Pax. Meanwhile, Fitz and Jemma begin the journey back to Earth but find something odd going on involving Izel.

episodes.title: Collision Course (Part II)
episodes.description: Sarge, Jaco, and Pax capture the Zephyr and prepare to go after Izel. The team in the trailer try to stop Sarge's bomb, and Izel questions Fitz-Simmons' loyalty.

episodes.title: Leap
episodes.description: After Melinda tells Yo-yo that she has no memory of shooting Sarge, a deadly game of hide-and-seek ensues as the team realizes that Izel can possess anyone she wishes.

episodes.title: From the Ashes
episodes.description: While Deke and Fitz-Simmons try to find a way to negate Izel's powers, Daisy tries to get Sarge to reveal who he truly is and Izel forces Marcus to take her to the temple.

episodes.title: The Sign
episodes.description: Izel uses Flint's powers to open a gateway to her dimension and bring her people through. Melinda tries to convince Sarge that he's a good person with or without Coulson, and Deke has enough of everyone looking down on him.

episodes.title: New Life
episodes.description: Melinda battles Izel, Daisy and Mack fight Sarge, and Yo-Yo deals with a problem from within. Fitz-Simmons have to deal with another situation where they have to change the course of their natural lives, and Sarge's true people prepare to invade Earth.

episodes.title: The New Deal
episodes.description: Coulson and the Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. are thrust backward in time and stranded in 1931 New York City. With the all-new Zephyr set to time-jump at any moment, the team must hurry to find out exactly what happened. If they fail, it would mean disaster for the past, present and future of the world.

episodes.title: Know Your Onions
episodes.description: With the identity of the timeline-unraveling "thread" revealed, the team's mission to protect him at all costs leads each agent to question their own values.

episodes.title: Alien Commies from the Future!
episodes.description: A surprise leap forward in time has stranded Enoch in 1931 and landed the team in yet another unfamiliar decade. Now, in order to stop the chronicoms from launching their newest future-dismantling plan, the agents will have to infiltrate one of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s most secure bases. They won't be able to succeed without help from a familiar face or two.

episodes.title: Out of the Past
episodes.description: It was just another average morning on July 22, 1955, when Agent Phil Coulson realized the importance of that day in the S.H.I.E.L.D. history books. With a chip on his shoulder and a genre-bending glitch in his system, he'd set into motion a chain of events that would hopefully preserve the timeline as we know it and ensure those pesky chronicoms get the ending they deserve. What could go wrong?

episodes.title: A Trout in the Milk
episodes.description: After a bumpy landing in the disco decade, the team – Daniel Sousa in tow – reunites with more than one familiar face at the S.H.I.E.L.D. hangout and discovers exactly how to dismantle the Chronicoms' latest plan. But when they get too close for comfort, the Zephyr unexpectedly leaps forward again, this time to a date pivotal to not only the future of S.H.I.E.L.D. but to the future of Director Mack as well.

episodes.title: Adapt or Die
episodes.description: The team must scramble to rescue Mack's parents, save S.H.I.E.L.D. from a chronicom infestation and fix the ship, all before the next time-jump. Meanwhile, Daisy and Sousa find themselves at a disadvantage against a power hungry Nathaniel Malick and his goons, and Coulson will have to do the thing he does best in order to save the future.

episodes.title: The Totally Excellent Adventures of Mack and the D
episodes.description: After being unexpectedly stranded in 1982, Mack retreats to his childhood home to process the death of his parents, while Deke gets to work scouting a chart-topping group of new agents. With no idea if or when the team is coming back for them, time seems to finally be on their side ... at least until the killer robots show up.

episodes.title: After, Before
episodes.description: With the Zephyr's time drive malfunctioning, the team is quite literally hurling toward disaster and Yo-Yo may be their only hope. The only problem? To get her powers back, she'll need to enlist the help of an old adversary and revisit part of her past long hidden away.

episodes.title: As I Have Always Been
episodes.description: A time storm ravages the Zephyr, propelling it toward destruction while simultaneously forcing Daisy and Coulson to relive their failed attempts to save the team over and over, until they find a solution or are swallowed by the storm. Making it to their next destination will take trust, courage and sacrifice from everyone on board, but it will all come down to having enough time.

episodes.title: Stolen
episodes.description: After Enoch's sacrifice propelled them out of the time storm, the team arrives back in 1983 where Nathanial and Kora are hard at work building an army of hand-selected anarchist Inhumans at Afterlife. When the agents split up to cover more ground, Daisy is tasked with protecting Jiaying and is compelled to confront her mother for the first time since her death; while the others quickly learn they'll need to face yet another supercharged former enemy in order to stop Malick.

episodes.title: Brand New Day
episodes.description: With the help of Kora on the inside, Sibyl and Nathanial continue their fight to shape a dark new future for S.H.I.E.L.D., managing to stay one step ahead of the agents along the way. If the team is going to turn this one around, they'll have to get creative, and maybe even a little out of this world.

episodes.title: The End Is at Hand
episodes.description: With their backs against the wall and Nathaniel and Sibyl edging ever closer to eliminating S.H.I.E.L.D. from the history books, the agents must rely on their strengths to outsmart and outlast the Chronicoms. This is their most important fight, and it will take the help of friends and teammates, past and present, to survive.

episodes.title: What We're Fighting For
episodes.description: This is their most important fight, and it will take the help of friends and teammates, past and present, to survive.

episodes.title: Avengers: Endgame
episodes.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.

episodes.title: Glorious Purpose
episodes.description: Loki, the God of Mischief, finds himself out of time and in an unusual place and forced — against his godly disposition — to cooperate with others. Welcome to the TVA, y'all!

episodes.title: The Variant
episodes.description: Mobius puts Loki to work investigating The Variant, but not everyone at the TVA is thrilled to be working alongside The God of Mischief.

episodes.title: Lamentis
episodes.description: Loki finds himself trapped in an apocalypse with a dead TemPad and the last person he wants by his side: the Loki Variant, Sylvie. Now the two must find their way off of the doomed moon before complete annihilation.

episodes.title: The Nexus Event
episodes.description: Loki and Sylvie find their way off the Lamentis-1 mere moments before complete annihilation. Now, the question on everyone's mind, especially those in charge of the TVA — how did these two variants create a Nexus Event in the face of an apocalypse?

episodes.title: Journey Into Mystery
episodes.description: Upon discovering the Time Keepers aren't real, Judge Renslayer prunes Loki with the Time Stick. Now in an unknown land surrounded by variant Lokis, they urge him to follow them. Meanwhile, turning on the judge, Sylvie demands to be told everything about the TVA.

episodes.title: For All Time. Always.
episodes.description: Loki and Sylvie arrive the Citadel at the End of Time. Will they finally discover who is behind the Time Variance Authority?

episodes.title: Filmed Before a Live Studio Audience
episodes.description: Wanda and Vision struggle to conceal their powers during dinner with Vision's boss and his wife.

episodes.title: Don't Touch That Dial
episodes.description: Wanda Maximoff and Vision bring illusion and glamour to Westview's talent show fundraiser.

episodes.title: Now in Color
episodes.description: After Wanda's pregnancy takes an unexpected turn, new friend Geraldine steps in to assist. Meanwhile, Vision gets closer to some of his Westview neighbors.

episodes.title: We Interrupt This Program
episodes.description: We travel to Westview with Captain Monica Rambeau and her team of S.W.O.R.D. agents as they try to figure out what's going on.

episodes.title: On a Very Special Episode…
episodes.description: On a very special episode of WandaVision , Wanda and Vision deal with their changing and expanding family — in more ways than one!

episodes.title: All-New Halloween Spooktacular!
episodes.description: Halloween has arrived in Westview! While Wanda and Uncle Pietro take Billy and Tommy trick-or-treating, Vision ventures out to the far side of town on a hunch.

episodes.title: Breaking the Fourth Wall
episodes.description: Wanda decides to take some much needed "me time," while Vision encounters detours along the way back home.

episodes.title: Previously On
episodes.description: Forced by Agatha Harkness, Wanda Maximoff must relive past memories as she charts the steps that led her to Westview.

episodes.title: The Series Finale
episodes.description: Wanda and Vision fight to save Westview.

episodes.show: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
episodes.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
episodes.description: Shang-Chi must confront the past he thought he left behind when he is drawn into the web of the mysterious Ten Rings organization.

episodes.key: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier|1|1
episodes.show: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
episodes.title: New World Order
episodes.description: Sam makes a tough decision while Bucky tries to lead a normal life.

episodes.key: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier|1|2
episodes.show: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
episodes.title: The Star Spangled Man
episodes.description: All eyes are on the shield, as Sam and Bucky decide to team up — or rather, work together — when a new global threat launches them into an unexpected mission that may hit too close to home. As the world meets its new Captain America, Sam and Bucky try to find a lead on the shadowy Flag Smashers.

episodes.key: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier|1|3
episodes.show: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
episodes.title: Power Broker
episodes.description: To find the source of the Super Soldier Serum, Sam and Bucky must scale a ladder of low-lifes starting in Madripoor with Zemo.

episodes.key: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier|1|4
episodes.show: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
episodes.title: The Whole World Is Watching
episodes.description: Sam, Bucky, and Zemo get closer to the Flag Smashers, while both Karli Morgenthau and John Walker make choices they can't undo.

episodes.key: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier|1|5
episodes.show: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
episodes.title: Truth
episodes.description: Sam, Bucky, Zemo, John Walker, and Karli Morgenthau must all deal with the fall out from their actions.

episodes.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
episodes.description: Peter Parker heads to Europe hoping for a normal summer, but elemental attacks and a mysterious new hero pull him back into a dangerous fight he isn't ready to embrace.

episodes.key: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier|1|6
episodes.show: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
episodes.title: One World, One People
episodes.description: Sam and Bucky head to New York City for the Global Repatriation Council vote after receiving a tip from Joaquin Torres who tracked activity on the Flag Smasher app in the city. They are going to need some help to take down Karli Morgenthau, who has been radicalized beyond salvation.

episodes.title: A Normal Amount of Rage
episodes.description: Jen Walters's world is turned upside down after a freak accident leaves her with superpowers.

episodes.title: Eternals
episodes.description: The Eternals are a team of ancient aliens who have been living on Earth in secret for thousands of years. When an unexpected tragedy forces them out of the shadows, they are forced to reunite against mankind’s most ancient enemy, the Deviants.

episodes.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
episodes.description: Peter Parker is unmasked and no longer able to separate his normal life from the high-stakes of being a super-hero. When he asks for help from Doctor Strange the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

episodes.key: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness|1|1
episodes.show: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
episodes.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
episodes.description: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.

episodes.title: Never Meet Your Heroes
episodes.description: Archer Kate Bishop lands in the middle of a criminal conspiracy, forcing Hawkeye out of retirement.

episodes.title: Hide and Seek
episodes.description: Clint has to help Kate disentangle herself from the Tracksuit mafia and a real-life murder mystery.

episodes.title: Echoes
episodes.description: After escaping a new threat, Clint and Kate join forces against an expanding criminal conspiracy.

episodes.title: Partners, Am I Right?
episodes.description: Secrets are revealed and hard truths emerge, culminating in a battle against two opposing forces.

episodes.title: Ronin
episodes.description: A fallout nearly derails their partnership, but Kate makes a discovery that changes everything.

episodes.title: So This Is Christmas?
episodes.description: Clint and Kate's partnership is tested as they face the consequences of exposing the conspiracy.

episodes.title: The Goldfish Problem
episodes.description: Steven Grant learns that he may be a superhero, but may also share a body with a ruthless mercenary.

episodes.title: Summon the Suit
episodes.description: With little time to react, Steven is thrust into a war of the gods as a mysterious partner arrives.

episodes.title: The Friendly Type
episodes.description: With Marc in the forefront and Harrow near Ammit's tomb, Marc needs to navigate Cairo while putting his differences aside with Layla and Steven without jeopardizing their mission.

episodes.title: The Tomb
episodes.description: Marc & Steven trek the Siwa Desert with Layla to find Ammit's tomb, but the threats ahead look to protect the goddess' resting place.

episodes.title: Asylum
episodes.description: Marc & Steven search through their memories to find their truth or become left behind.

episodes.title: Gods and Monsters
episodes.description: As Moon Knight joins the fray, Marc, Steven, and Khonshu must work together to stop Ammit.

episodes.title: Superhuman Law
episodes.description: Jen is hired at a prestigious law firm but must practice as She-Hulk and rep a complicated client.

episodes.title: The People vs. Emil Blonsky
episodes.description: She-Hulk represents Emil Blonsky aka The Abomination, but his parole hearing doesn't go as planned.

episodes.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
episodes.description: Queen Ramonda, Shuri, M’Baku, Okoye and the Dora Milaje fight to protect their nation from intervening world powers in the wake of King T’Challa’s death.  As the Wakandans strive to embrace their next chapter, the heroes must band together with the help of War Dog Nakia and Everett Ross and forge a new path for the kingdom of Wakanda.

episodes.title: Chafa
episodes.description: After her mother's tragic death, young Maya is forced to leave her hometown of Tamaha, Oklahoma, and move to New York City where she meets Wilson Fisk, aka Kingpin, who raises her to be a ruthless assassin. After learning that Fisk had her father killed, Maya kills Kingpin and flees NYC.

episodes.title: Lowak
episodes.description: Maya enlists the help of her disapproving family to take down Fisk's army. Meanwhile, she begins experiencing strange visions.

episodes.title: Tuklo
episodes.description: Maya learns the meaning of collateral damage as Fisk's ruthless army arrives in Tamaha, Oklahoma.

episodes.title: Taloa
episodes.description: Maya finds herself at a crossroads, facing the shadows of her past and contemplating her future.

episodes.title: Maya
episodes.description: The lives of Maya's family hang in the balance as Fisk's army invades the Choctaw Nation powwow.

episodes.title: Is This Not Real Magic?
episodes.description: She-Hulk's new client Wong is suing a magician for unauthorized use of the Mystic Arts.

episodes.title: Mean, Green, and Straight Poured into These Jeans
episodes.description: She-Hulk discovers Titania owns the name "She-Hulk" and is suing her for trademark infringement.

episodes.title: Just Jen
episodes.description: Jen is a bridesmaid in a friend's wedding, a stressful event compounded by uniquely She-Hulk issues.

episodes.title: The Retreat
episodes.description: Jen visits Blonsky's wellness retreat, meets new friends and gets in touch with her inner She-Hulk.

episodes.title: Ribbit and Rip it
episodes.description: She-Hulk represents Leap-Frog who was injured due to a malfunction in his custom-made super suit.

episodes.title: Whose Show Is This?
episodes.description: Jen finds herself in trouble with the law and struggles to pick up the pieces of her life.

episodes.title: Generation Why
episodes.description: Kamala Khan attends Avengercon only to discover that she herself might have superpowers.

episodes.title: Crushed
episodes.description: Kamala Khan discovers her new superpowers are super-handy for staying out of trouble.

episodes.title: Destined
episodes.description: Ahead of Aamir's wedding, Kamala may face grave consequences due to a crucial decision she makes.

episodes.title: Seeing Red
episodes.description: Kamala travels around the world to solve the mystery of the bangle and her family's history.

episodes.title: Time and Again
episodes.description: The bangle reveals to Kamala secrets about her family lineage, as well as the truth behind the Veil.

episodes.title: No Normal
episodes.description: Back in Jersey, Kamala fights to save her friends from the clutches of Damage Control.

episodes.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
episodes.description: After his retirement is interrupted by Gorr the God Butcher, a galactic killer who seeks the extinction of the gods, Thor Odinson enlists the help of King Valkyrie, Korg, and ex-girlfriend Jane Foster, who now wields Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor. Together they embark upon a harrowing cosmic adventure to uncover the mystery of the God Butcher’s vengeance and stop him before it’s too late.

episodes.title: Take Me Home
episodes.description: MIT student Riri Williams builds an advanced armor suit inspired by Tony Stark. While dealing with challenges as a young black woman in tech, she confronts a tech-based threat and must decide if she's ready to become Ironheart.

episodes.title: Will the Real Natalie Please Stand Up?
episodes.description: Riri's new A.I. dredges up painful memories ahead of her first heist with Parker and his crew.

episodes.title: We in Danger, Girl
episodes.description: Riri is uncomfortable being part of Parker's crew -- two more heists, max, and she's out, she promises.

episodes.title: Bad Magic
episodes.description: When Parker suspects Riri of wrongdoing, she knows she has to figure out the source of his powers.

episodes.title: Karma's a Glitch
episodes.description: Riri sets out to create a suit unlike anything she has ever attempted--but at what cost?

episodes.title: The Past Is the Past
episodes.description: Riri builds her most powerful suit yet, but she's unsure if it's enough to beat Parker and The Hood.

episodes.title: Werewolf by Night
episodes.description: On a dark and somber night, a secret cabal of monster hunters emerge from the shadows and gather at the foreboding Bloodstone Temple following the death of their leader. In a strange and macabre memorial to the leader’s life, the attendees are thrust into a mysterious and deadly competition for a powerful relic—a hunt that will ultimately bring them face to face with a dangerous monster.

episodes.key: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special|1|1
episodes.show: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
episodes.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
episodes.description: On a mission to make Christmas unforgettable for Quill, the Guardians head to Earth in search of the perfect present.

episodes.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
episodes.description: Super-Hero partners Scott Lang and Hope van Dyne, along with with Hope's parents Janet van Dyne and Hank Pym, and Scott's daughter Cassie Lang, find themselves exploring the Quantum Realm, interacting with strange new creatures and embarking on an adventure that will push them beyond the limits of what they thought possible.

episodes.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
episodes.description: Still reeling from the loss of Gamora, Peter Quill rallies his team to defend the universe and one of their own - a mission that could mean the end of the Guardians if not successful.

episodes.title: Resurrection
episodes.description: Nick Fury learns of a clandestine invasion of Earth by Skrulls.

episodes.title: Promises
episodes.description: Fury grapples with past and present.

episodes.title: Betrayed
episodes.description: Fury uncovers a rebel Skrull plot.

episodes.title: Beloved
episodes.description: Fury must make some hard sacrifices.

episodes.title: Harvest
episodes.description: Fury gathers his allies. Gravik deals with unrest.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.description: All hope for humanity rests on Fury's shoulders.

episodes.title: The Marvels
episodes.description: When her duties send her to an anomalous wormhole linked to a Kree revolutionary, Carol's powers become entangled with that of Jersey City super-fan Kamala Khan, aka Ms. Marvel, and Carol's estranged niece, now S.A.B.E.R. astronaut Captain Monica Rambeau. Together, this unlikely trio must team up and learn to work in concert to save the universe.

episodes.title: Ouroboros
episodes.description: Loki finds himself lost to time and torn, quite literally, between past, present and future.

episodes.title: Breaking Brad
episodes.description: With the TVA on the verge of a temporal meltdown, Loki & Mobius will stop at nothing to find Sylvie.
Loki & Mobius go on the hunt to find everyone's favorite cartoon clock as they try to save the TVA.

episodes.title: Heart of the TVA
episodes.description: The TVA's Loom nears catastrophic failure but Loki, Mobius and Sylvie have a He Who Remains variant.

episodes.title: Science/Fiction
episodes.description: Loki traverses dying timelines in attempt to find his friends, but Reality is not what it seems.

episodes.title: Glorious Purpose
episodes.description: The clock is ticking in the season finale which finds Loki and Sylvie on a date with destiny.

episodes.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
episodes.description: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.

episodes.title: Seekest Thou the Road
episodes.description: In the small town Westview, Detective Agnes' murder case sends her down a road that changes everything.

episodes.title: Circle Sewn with Fate Unlock Thy Hidden Gate
